The outermost outside parameter is substituted
    clear IHΘr.
    unfold all_assumptions in HΘa; apply Forall_app in HΘa as [HΘr He1]; apply Forall_cons_iff in He1 as [(κ & B & ->) _].
    cbn [mdesc_at]; rewrite tele_split_last.
    do 2 eexists; split; [ reflexivity | split; [ cbn; rewrite Hp; reflexivity |] ].
    cbn [mdesc_read].
    pose proof (mdesc_ats_read_sub _ _ _ (Id ⨟ sb_qn (List.length Θr) (Id,,N)) Hats) as Hats'.
    rewrite (mdesc_sub_fix R 0) in Hats' by (exact HsR || (intros; lia)).
    rewrite Hats'; cbn [option_map]; eexists; split; [ reflexivity |]; rewrite mdesc_mod_up, mdesc_mod_named.
    rewrite (mdesc_mod_sub _ _ _ HQ); cbn [option_map].
    assert (HRsm : mdesc_mod (mdesc_up (Θr ++ ce_ass κ B :: nil) (mdesc_named (Θr ++ ce_ass κ B :: nil) Ns (apps (a_mem (qname_mod p) y) Ns) R1))
                   = Some (mdesc_up (Θr ++ ce_ass κ B :: nil) Q))
      by (rewrite mdesc_mod_up, mdesc_mod_named, HQ; reflexivity).
    destruct (mdesc_at_mod_part _ _ _ _ Hat HRsm) as (Rm' & HRm' & ->).
    rewrite mdesc_at_up in HRm'; injection HRm' as <-.
    pose proof (mdesc_mod_is_mod _ _ HQ) as HQm.
    rewrite (mdesc_is_mod_mod _ (mdesc_is_mod_up _ _ (mdesc_is_mod_sub _ _ HQm))).
    do 2 f_equal; apply mdesc_sub_sb_eq; rewrite sb_compose_id_left; reflexivity.
Qed.

The entry y of an open module, read, then given the next parameter, is the entry read in the module given it: the parameter is substituted into the body (mdenote_sub_all), and the entries before the entry filled in alike (gm_fill_sub).
Lemma sel_at_open : forall Θc Ξc, gctx_closed Θc Ξc ->
    forall Γ Δ Φw Φx N R0m' y Γy E rd R Rs Rs',
    ctx_scoped 0 Γ -> mdesc_scoped (List.length Γ) (mdesc_open Δ Φw Φx) -> all_assumptions Δ ->
    mdesc_at (mdesc_open Δ Φw Φx) N = Some R0m' ->
    mdesc_entry (mdesc_open Δ Φw Φx) y = Some (Γy, E, rd) ->
    edenote Θc Ξc (Γy ++ Γ) None E R -> mdesc_read rd R = Some Rs ->
    mdesc_at Rs N = Some Rs' ->
    exists Γy' E' rd' R', mdesc_entry R0m' y = Some (Γy', E', rd') /\
      edenote Θc Ξc (Γy' ++ Γ) None E' R' /\ mdesc_read rd' R' = Some Rs'.
Proof.
  intros Θc Ξc Hc * HΓ Hs HΔa Hat0 He Hed Hrd Hat.
  pose proof (mdesc_entry_scoped _ _ _ _ _ _ Hs He) as (HsΓy & HsE & _).
  destruct Δ as [| e Δ0 _] using rev_ind; [ cbn in Hat0; discriminate |].
  unfold all_assumptions in HΔa; apply Forall_app in HΔa as [HΔ0 He1]; apply Forall_cons_iff in He1 as [(κ & B & ->) _].
  cbn [mdesc_at] in Hat0; rewrite tele_split_last in Hat0; injection Hat0 as <-.
  set (σ := sb_qn (List.length Δ0) (Id,,N)).
  rewrite (gmod_sub_sb_eq Φw _ σ), (gmod_sub_sb_eq Φx _ σ) by (rewrite sb_compose_id_left; reflexivity).
  pose proof He as He0; cbn in He0.
  destruct (gm_prefix_upto Φx y) as [[| Φ' z E0 | ] |] eqn:Hp; try discriminate.
  destruct (gm_prefix_entry _ _ _ Hp) as (? & ? & Heq & _); injection Heq as <- -> <-.
The read fills the entries before it
  cbn [mdesc_read] in Hrd.
  assert (HE : exists σf, gm_fill Φ' = Some σf /\ rd = reader_open (Δ0 ++ ce_ass κ B :: nil) Φ' /\
                 Γy = body_ctx Φ' ++ Δ0 ++ ce_ass κ B :: nil /\ E = E0 /\
                 mdesc_entry (mdesc_open (tele_sub Δ0 (Id,,N)) (gmod_sub Φw σ) (gmod_sub Φx σ)) y =
                   Some (body_ctx (gmod_sub Φ' σ) ++ tele_sub Δ0 (Id,,N), gentry_sub E0 (sb_qn (gm_binders Φ') σ),
                         reader_open (tele_sub Δ0 (Id,,N)) (gmod_sub Φ' σ))).
  { cbn [mdesc_entry]; rewrite gm_prefix_upto_sub, Hp; cbn [option_map gmod_sub].
    destruct E0 as [[|] pv r A [M |] | pv U | | pv A M U |]; try discriminate; injection He0 as <- <- <-;
      cbn [mdesc_read] in Hrd; destruct (gm_fill Φ') as [σf |]; cbn [option_map] in Hrd; try discriminate;
      exists σf; repeat split. }
  destruct HE as (σf & Hf & -> & -> & -> & HE').
  cbn [mdesc_read] in Hrd; rewrite Hf in Hrd; cbn [option_map] in Hrd; injection Hrd as <-.
  rewrite mdesc_at_up in Hat; injection Hat as <-.
  pose proof (gm_fill_nopens _ _ Hf) as Hno.
  set (s := sb_qn (gm_binders Φ') σ).
  exists (body_ctx (gmod_sub Φ' σ) ++ tele_sub Δ0 (Id,,N)), (gentry_sub E0 s), (reader_open (tele_sub Δ0 (Id,,N)) (gmod_sub Φ' σ)),
    (mdesc_sub R s).
  split; [ exact HE' | split ].
  -
The entry denotes, substituted
    assert (Hsc : sub_mod_compat s ((body_ctx (gmod_sub Φ' σ) ++ tele_sub Δ0 (Id,,N)) ++ Γ)
                    ((body_ctx Φ' ++ Δ0 ++ ce_ass κ B :: nil) ++ Γ)).
    { pose proof (sub_mod_compat_ext (body_ctx Φ' ++ Δ0) (Id,,N) Γ (ce_ass κ B :: Γ) (sub_mod_compat_single Γ κ B N)) as H.
      rewrite tele_sub_app, length_app, sb_qn_plus in H.
      rewrite body_ctx_sub by exact Hno.
      unfold s, σ; rewrite <- (length_body_ctx _ Hno).
      replace ((body_ctx Φ' ++ Δ0 ++ ce_ass κ B :: nil) ++ Γ) with ((body_ctx Φ' ++ Δ0) ++ ce_ass κ B :: Γ)
        by (rewrite <- !app_assoc; reflexivity).
      exact H. }
    eapply (proj1 (proj2 (proj2 (mdenote_sub_all _ _ Hc)))); [ exact Hed | | rewrite <- length_app in HsE; exact HsE | exact Hsc ].
    apply slots_ok_ctx, ctx_scoped_app_iff; split; [ exact HsΓy | exact HΓ ].
  -
The entries before it filled in alike
    destruct (gm_fill_sub Φ' (List.length Δ0) (Id,,N) σf Hf) as (τ' & Hf' & Hτ).
    cbn [mdesc_read]; fold σ in Hf'; rewrite Hf'; cbn [option_map]; do 2 f_equal.
    fold σ.
    rewrite (mdesc_sub_sub_ext R s τ' (σf ⨟ σ)), (mdesc_sub_sub_ext R σf σ (σf ⨟ σ)); [ reflexivity | reflexivity |].
    unfold s, σ; rewrite <- sb_qn_plus; exact Hτ.
Qed.

Section Fixed_GCtx.
  Context {GC : GCtx}.
  Import Fixed_Notations.

The members x of two typed module expressions with the same module part, looked up alike, are equal: through their common δ-reduct, or, with none, as the filed member of the bare stored body the module part is (mem_alias_filed).
Lemma wf_exp_eq_mem_same_part : forall Γ H0 H1 x R A R0 R1,
    gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵐ H0 ≈ H0 -> gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵐ H1 ≈ H1 ->
    mdenote gc_deps gc_stack Γ (me_mem H0 x) R -> mdenote gc_deps gc_stack Γ (me_mem H1 x) R ->
    mdesc_type R = Some A ->
    mdenote gc_deps gc_stack Γ H0 R0 -> mdenote gc_deps gc_stack Γ H1 R1 -> mdesc_mod R0 = mdesc_mod R1 ->
    gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ⍮ Γ ⊢ a_mem H0 x ≈ a_mem H1 x : A.
Proof.
  intros * HH0 HH1 Hm0 Hm1 Ht HR0 HR1 Ep.
  pose proof (ctx_wf_gctx _ _ _ (presup_modexp_eq_ctx HH0)) as Hg.
  destruct (mdesc_reduct R) as [M |] eqn:Hr.
  -
Both are the reduct
    eapply wf_exp_eq_trans; [ eapply wf_exp_eq_mem_delta; eassumption |].
    apply wf_exp_eq_sym; eapply wf_exp_eq_mem_delta; eassumption.
  -
Both are the filed member of the bare body
    destruct (mem_no_red _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hm0 Ht Hr) as (R0' & p & T & Φ & _ & _ & _ & _ & _ & HR0' & Hmd0 & _).
    destruct (mem_no_red _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hm1 Ht Hr) as (R1' & p' & T' & Φ' & _ & _ & _ & _ & _ & HR1' & Hmd1 & _).
    rewrite (proj1 (mdenote_functional_all _ _ Hg) _ _ _ HR0' _ HR0) in Hmd0.
    rewrite (proj1 (mdenote_functional_all _ _ Hg) _ _ _ HR1' _ HR1) in Hmd1.
    assert (HR0m : mdesc_mod R0 = Some (mdesc_closed nil p' T' Φ' nil)) by congruence.
    eapply wf_exp_eq_trans; [ exact (mem_alias_filed _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HH0 HR0 HR0m Hm0 Ht) |].
    apply wf_exp_eq_sym; exact (mem_alias_filed _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HH1 HR1 Hmd1 Hm1 Ht).
Qed.

A term glued as the member of H1 is glued as the member of a typed H0 with the same module part, looked up alike, at the same type: the members are equal (wf_exp_eq_mem_same_part), read where the gluing is.
Lemma glu_elem_at_same_part : forall {Γ1 H0 H1 x R A' Δ σ1 a m R0 R1 Rm} {i : nat} {P El},
    gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ⍮ Γ1 ⊢ᵐ H0 ≈ H0 -> gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ⍮ Γ1 ⊢ᵐ H1 ≈ H1 ->
    mdenote gc_deps gc_stack Γ1 (me_mem H0 x) R ->
    mdenote gc_deps gc_stack Γ1 (me_mem H1 x) R ->
    mdesc_type R = Some A' ->
    mdenote gc_deps gc_stack Γ1 H0 R0 -> mdenote gc_deps gc_stack Γ1 H1 R1 ->
    mdesc_mod R0 = Some Rm -> mdesc_mod R1 = Some Rm ->
    Δ ⊢ˢ σ1 : Γ1 ->
    glu_elem_at Δ A'[σ1] (a_mem H1 x)[σ1] a m i P El ->
    glu_elem_at Δ A'[σ1] (a_mem H0 x)[σ1] a m i P El.
Proof.
  intros * HH0 HH1 Hm0 Hm1 HA HR0 HR1 E0 E1 Hσ [Hu HT HM].
  constructor; [ exact Hu | exact HT |].
  eapply glu_univ_elem_trm_resp_exp_eq; [ exact Hu | exact HM |].
  apply wf_exp_eq_sym; cbn [exp_sub].
  eapply wf_exp_eq_mem_same_part;
    [ exact (sub_preserves_modexp _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HH0 Hσ) | exact (sub_preserves_modexp _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HH1 Hσ)
    | eapply wf_sub_mdenote_mem; [ exact HH0 | exact Hm0 | exact Hσ ]
    | eapply wf_sub_mdenote_mem; [ exact HH1 | exact Hm1 | exact Hσ ]
    | eapply mdesc_type_sub; exact HA
    | eapply wf_sub_mdenote; [ exact HH0 | exact HR0 | exact Hσ ]
    | eapply wf_sub_mdenote; [ exact HH1 | exact HR1 | exact Hσ ]
    | rewrite (mdesc_mod_sub _ _ _ E0), (mdesc_mod_sub _ _ _ E1); reflexivity ].
Qed.

A typed module expression has a module part, the one of whatever it denotes.
Lemma modexp_mod_part : forall Γ H R, gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵐ H ≈ H -> mdenote gc_deps gc_stack Γ H R ->
    exists Rm, mdesc_mod R = Some Rm.
Proof.
  intros * HH Hm.
  destruct (me_denotes _ _ _ _ _ HH) as (R0 & Rm & Hm0 & HRm).
  pose proof (ctx_wf_gctx _ _ _ (presup_modexp_eq_ctx HH)) as Hg.
  rewrite (proj1 (mdenote_functional_all _ _ Hg) _ _ _ Hm0 _ Hm) in HRm; eauto.
Qed.

A module value glued as H1 is glued as a typed H0 with the same module part both ways at every substitution, neither naming an open frame: as glu_dmod_same_part, with no equation between them; the members are equal through the module part (glu_elem_at_same_part).
Lemma glu_dmod_same_part_typed :
  (forall Δ σ0 Γ0 H1 h, glu_dmod Δ σ0 Γ0 H1 h ->
     forall H0, gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ⍮ Γ0 ⊢ᵐ H0 ≈ H0 -> same_part Γ0 H0 H1 -> same_part Γ0 H1 H0 ->
       (forall Γ1 ζ, Γ1 ⊢ˢ ζ : Γ0 -> names_no_frame H0[ζ]ᵐ) ->
       (forall Γ1 ζ, Γ1 ⊢ˢ ζ : Γ0 -> names_no_frame H1[ζ]ᵐ) ->
       glu_dmod Δ σ0 Γ0 H0 h) /\
  (forall Δ ts ρ Ms Ns args, glu_tele_args Δ ts ρ Ms Ns args -> True).
Proof.
  apply glu_dmod_mut_ind_all; [ | | | intros; exact I | intros; exact I ].
  -
A global module
    intros * Hσ HH1 Hl Hlen Hdesc Hargs _ H0 HH Hs01 Hs10 Hq0 Hq1.
The same module part, read off H1[ζ]
    assert (Hpart : forall Δ' φ Γ1 ζ σ1 RH, glu_sub_through Δ σ0 Γ0 Δ' φ Γ1 ζ σ1 ->
               mdenote gc_deps gc_stack Γ1 H0[ζ]ᵐ RH ->
               exists R1, mdenote gc_deps gc_stack Γ1 H1[ζ]ᵐ R1 /\ mdesc_mod R1 = mdesc_mod RH).
    { intros * Hst Hm.
      pose proof (glu_sub_through_mid _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hst) as Hζ.
      destruct (modexp_mod_part _ _ _ (sub_preserves_modexp _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HH Hζ) Hm) as (Rm & HRm).
      destruct (Hs01 _ _ _ _ Hζ Hm HRm) as (R1 & Hm1 & HR1m).
      exists R1; split; [ exact Hm1 | congruence ]. }
    eapply glu_dmod_global; [ exact Hσ | exact HH | exact Hl | exact Hlen | |].
    + intros * Hst Hm.
      destruct (Hpart _ _ _ _ _ _ Hst Hm) as (R1 & Hm1 & E1).
      rewrite <- E1; exact (Hdesc _ _ _ _ _ _ Hst Hm1).
    + intros * Hst Hm HNs.
      destruct (Hpart _ _ _ _ _ _ Hst Hm) as (R1 & Hm1 & E1).
      rewrite <- E1 in HNs; exact (Hargs _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hst Hm1 HNs).
  -
A body
    intros * Hσ HH1 Hmem Hsub IHsub H0 HH Hs01 Hs10 Hq0 Hq1.
    apply glu_dmod_body; [ exact Hσ | exact HH | | ].
    + intros * Hp Ht Hk Hb.
      destruct (Hmem _ _ _ _ _ _ Hp Ht Hk Hb) as (a & m & [Ea Em Hg]).
      exists a, m; constructor; [ exact Ea | exact Em |].
      intros * Hst Hm HA HS HAt.
      pose proof (glu_sub_through_mid _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hst) as Hζ.
      pose proof (same_denote_mem_part x Hs01 Hq0 _ _ _ Hζ Hm) as Hm1.
      destruct (Hg _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hst Hm1 HA HS HAt) as (i & P & El & Hgl).
      exists i, P, El.
      pose proof (sub_preserves_modexp _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HH Hζ) as HH0ζ.
      pose proof (sub_preserves_modexp _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HH1 Hζ) as HH1ζ.
      destruct (me_denotes _ _ _ _ _ HH0ζ) as (R0 & Rm & HR0 & HRm).
      destruct (Hs01 _ _ _ _ Hζ HR0 HRm) as (R1 & HR1 & HR1m).
      exact (glu_elem_at_same_part HH0ζ HH1ζ Hm Hm1 HA HR0 HR1 HRm HR1m (glu_sub_through_rest _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hst) Hgl).
    + intros * Hp Hu Hb Hc.
      pose proof (Hsub _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hp Hu Hb Hc) as Hg1.
      pose proof (same_denote_mem_part y Hs01 Hq0) as Hd01.
      pose proof (same_denote_mem_part y Hs10 Hq1) as Hd10.
The selection from H0 is typed: it denotes what the one from H1 does
      assert (HHy : gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ⍮ Γ0 ⊢ᵐ me_mem H0 y ≈ me_mem H0 y).
      { assert (HHy1 : gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ⍮ Γ0 ⊢ᵐ me_mem H1 y ≈ me_mem H1 y) by (destruct Hg1; assumption).
        destruct (me_mod_tele_exists HHy1) as (R & T & HR & HT).
        assert (HR0 : mdenote gc_deps gc_stack Γ0 (me_mem H0 y) R).
        { pose proof (Hd10 _ Id R (wf_sub_id _ _ _ (presup_modexp_eq_ctx HH))) as Hd; rewrite !modexp_sub_id in Hd; exact (Hd HR). }
        eapply wf_me_mem; [ exact HH | exact HR0 | exact HT | exact HR0 | exact HT ]. }
      eapply IHsub; [ exact Hp | exact Hu | exact Hb | exact Hc | exact HHy
                    | exact (same_part_of_denote Hd01) | exact (same_part_of_denote Hd10)
                    | intros Γ2 ζ Hζ; apply names_no_frame_mem; [ exact (ctx_wf_gctx _ _ _ (wf_sub_cod _ _ _ _ _ Hζ)) | exact (Hq0 _ _ Hζ) ]
                    | intros Γ2 ζ Hζ; apply names_no_frame_mem; [ exact (ctx_wf_gctx _ _ _ (wf_sub_cod _ _ _ _ _ Hζ)) | exact (Hq1 _ _ Hζ) ] ].
  -
A value lacking a parameter
    intros * Hσ HH1 Hn Hpar Happ IHapp H0 HH Hs01 Hs10 Hq0 Hq1.
    eapply glu_dmod_fun; [ exact Hσ | exact HH | exact Hn | | ].
    + intros * Hst Hm.
      pose proof (glu_sub_through_mid _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hst) as Hζ.
      destruct (modexp_mod_part _ _ _ (sub_preserves_modexp _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HH Hζ) Hm) as (Rm & HRm).
      destruct (Hs01 _ _ _ _ Hζ Hm HRm) as (RH1 & Hm1 & HRm1).
      destruct (Hpar _ _ _ _ _ _ Hst Hm1) as (T & B & T1 & [HT Hv Hgl]).
      exists T, B, T1; constructor; [| exact Hv | exact Hgl ].
      exact (mdesc_mod_tele_part _ _ _ HT (ex_intro _ Rm (conj HRm1 HRm))).
    + intros * Hst Hm HT Hv HS HB * Hu HP HN Hhc.
      pose proof (glu_sub_through_mid _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hst) as Hζ.
      assert (HRm : exists Rm, mdesc_mod RH = Some Rm)
        by (unfold mdesc_mod_tele in HT; destruct (mdesc_mod RH); [ eexists; reflexivity | discriminate ]).
      destruct HRm as [Rm HRm].
      destruct (Hs01 _ _ _ _ Hζ Hm HRm) as (RH1 & Hm1 & HRm1).
      pose proof (mdesc_mod_tele_part _ _ _ HT (ex_intro _ Rm (conj HRm HRm1))) as HT1.
      pose proof (Happ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hst Hm1 HT1 Hv HS HB _ _ _ _ _ _ Hu HP HN Hhc) as Hg1.
      pose proof (same_part_sub Hζ Hs01) as Hs01'; pose proof (same_part_sub Hζ Hs10) as Hs10'.
      eapply IHapp; [ exact Hst | exact Hm1 | exact HT1 | exact Hv | exact HS | exact HB | exact Hu | exact HP | exact HN
                    | exact Hhc | | exact (same_part_app_var _ _ Hs01') | exact (same_part_app_var _ _ Hs10')
                    | intros; apply names_no_frame_of_none; reflexivity | intros; apply names_no_frame_of_none; reflexivity ].
The application of H0 is typed: its premises are those of H1's application, the module parts being the same
      assert (HHg : gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ⍮ Γ1 ▹{domain_kind a} B ⊢ᵐ me_app H1[ζ]ᵐ[Wk]ᵐ #0 ≈ me_app H1[ζ]ᵐ[Wk]ᵐ #0)
        by (destruct Hg1; assumption).
      destruct (proj1 (modexp_gen _ _ _ _ _ HHg)) as [HH1w (R' & T' & B' & T1' & S' & HR' & HT' & Hv' & HB' & HS' & HN')].
      assert (HRm' : exists Rm', mdesc_mod R' = Some Rm')
        by (unfold mdesc_mod_tele in HT'; destruct (mdesc_mod R'); [ eexists; reflexivity | discriminate ]).
      destruct HRm' as [Rm' HRm'].
      destruct (Hs10' (Γ1 ▹{domain_kind a} B) Wk R' Rm' ltac:(eapply wf_sub_shift; exact (presup_modexp_eq_ctx HHg)) HR' HRm')
        as (R0 & HR0 & HRm0).
      pose proof (mdesc_mod_tele_part _ _ _ HT' (ex_intro _ Rm' (conj HRm' HRm0))) as HT0.
      assert (HHw : gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ⍮ Γ1 ▹{domain_kind a} B ⊢ᵐ H0[ζ]ᵐ[Wk]ᵐ ≈ H0[ζ]ᵐ[Wk]ᵐ).
      { eapply sub_preserves_modexp; [ exact (sub_preserves_modexp _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HH Hζ) |].
        eapply wf_sub_shift; exact (presup_modexp_eq_ctx HHg). }
      eapply wf_me_app; [ exact HHw | exact HR0 | exact HT0 | exact Hv' | exact HB' | exact HS' | exact HN'
                        | apply wf_exp_eq_refl; exact HN' | exact HR0 | exact HT0 | exact Hv' | exact HB' | exact HS' | exact HN' ].
Qed.

A module description whose telescope has an outermost parameter takes the next argument.
Lemma mdesc_at_of_view : forall Γ R0m N T0 B T1, desc_ok gc_deps gc_stack Γ R0m -> mdesc_is_mod R0m ->
    mdesc_tele R0m = Some T0 -> tele_view T0 = Some (B, T1) ->
    exists R0m', mdesc_at R0m N = Some R0m'.
Proof.
  intros * Hok Hm HT Hv.
  destruct R0m as [| Δ Φw Φx | Θ p T Φ Ns |]; cbn in Hm; try contradiction; cbn [mdesc_at].
  - cbn in HT; injection HT as ->; unfold tele_view in Hv.
    destruct (tele_split (rev T0)) as [[[? ?] ?] | τ] eqn:Hs; [ eexists; reflexivity | exfalso ].
    inversion Hok; subst.
    destruct T0 as [| e T0' _] using rev_ind; [ discriminate |].
    match goal with Ha : all_assumptions (T0' ++ e :: nil) |- _ =>
      unfold all_assumptions in Ha; apply Forall_app in Ha as [_ Ha]; apply Forall_cons_iff in Ha as [(κ & X & ->) _] end.
    rewrite tele_split_last in Hs; discriminate.
  - destruct (tele_split (rev Θ)) as [[[? ?] ?] | ?]; eexists; reflexivity.
Qed.

A selection from X, then applied to N, has the module part of the selection from X applied to N, when X, naming no open frame, has a next parameter: X given N takes the entry alike (sel_at_open, sel_at_closed).
Lemma mdenote_mem_app_of_app_mem : forall Γ X N y R1 Rm1,
    gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵐ X ≈ X -> names_no_frame (me_mem X y) ->
    (forall R0 T0, mdenote gc_deps gc_stack Γ X R0 -> mdesc_mod_tele R0 = Some T0 -> exists B T1, tele_view T0 = Some (B, T1)) ->
    mdenote gc_deps gc_stack Γ (me_app (me_mem X y) N) R1 -> mdesc_mod R1 = Some Rm1 ->
    exists R2, mdenote gc_deps gc_stack Γ (me_mem (me_app X N) y) R2 /\ mdesc_mod R2 = Some Rm1.
Proof.
  intros * HH Hq Hv Hm1 HRm1.
  pose proof (presup_modexp_eq_ctx HH) as HwΓ.
  pose proof (ctx_wf_gctx _ _ _ HwΓ) as Hg.
  pose proof (wf_gctx_closed _ _ _ HwΓ) as Hc.
  destruct (wf_modexp_eq_scoped _ _ _ _ _ HH) as (HΓ & _ & _).
  inversion Hm1 as [? ? ? ? ? Hq1 _ | ? ? ? ? ? ? ? ? ? Hq1 _ | | | ? ? ? Rsel ? Hsel Hat | | ? ? ? ? ? ? Hq1 _]; subst;
    try (cbn in Hq1; discriminate).
The selection has a module part, as its application does
  assert (HRsel : exists Rsm, mdesc_mod Rsel = Some Rsm).
  { destruct (mdesc_mod Rsel) as [Rsm |] eqn:E; [ eauto |].
    rewrite (mdesc_at_no_mod _ _ _ E Hat) in HRm1; discriminate. }
  destruct HRsel as (Rsm & HRsel).
  apply (mdenote_mem_no_frame _ _ _ _ _ Hg Hq Hsel); intros R0 R0m Γy E rd R Hm0 HR0m He Hed Hrd.
  pose proof (desc_ok_mod _ _ Hg _ _ _ (me_desc_ok _ _ _ _ _ _ HH Hm0) HR0m) as Hok.
  pose proof (mdesc_mod_scoped _ _ _ (wf_mdenote_scoped _ _ _ _ _ _ HH Hm0) HR0m) as Hs0.
  pose proof (mdesc_mod_is_mod _ _ HR0m) as HisR0m.
The module part of X takes N
  destruct (desc_ok_tele _ _ _ _ Hok HisR0m) as (T0 & HT0).
  destruct (Hv _ T0 Hm0 ltac:(unfold mdesc_mod_tele; rewrite HR0m; exact HT0)) as (B & T1 & HvT).
  destruct (mdesc_at_of_view _ _ N _ _ _ Hok HisR0m HT0 HvT) as (R0m' & HR0m').
  destruct (mdesc_at_of_mod_part _ _ _ _ HR0m HR0m') as (R0' & HR0' & HmR0').
  rewrite (mdesc_is_mod_mod _ (mdesc_at_is_mod _ _ _ HisR0m HR0m')) in HmR0'.
  assert (HmX : mdenote gc_deps gc_stack Γ (me_app X N) R0') by (eapply mdenote_app; eassumption).
  destruct R0m as [| Δ Φw Φx | Θ p T Φ Ns |]; cbn in HisR0m; try contradiction.
  -
An open module
    inversion Hok; subst.
    destruct (sel_at_open _ _ Hc _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HΓ Hs0 ltac:(assumption) HR0m' He Hed Hrd Hat)
      as (Γy' & E' & rd' & R' & He' & Hed' & Hrd').
    exists R1; split; [| exact HRm1 ].
    assert (Hpath : mdesc_entry_path R0m' y = None)
      by (cbn [mdesc_at] in HR0m'; destruct (tele_split (rev Δ)) as [[[? ?] ?] | ?];
          [ injection HR0m' as <-; reflexivity | discriminate ]).
    eapply mdenote_mem; [ exact HmX | exact HmR0' | exact He' | rewrite Hpath; exact Hed' | exact Hrd' ].
  -
A closed module
    inversion Hok; subst.
    match goal with Hg0 : ⊢ᵍ ?Θ0 ⍮ ?Ξ0, Hloc : loc ?Θ0 ?Ξ0 p T Φ |- _ =>
      pose proof (loc_coherent _ _ Hg0 _ _ _ Hloc) as Hco end.
    match goal with H : all_assumptions T |- _ => rename H into HTa end.
    match goal with H : all_assumptions Θ |- _ => rename H into HΘa end.
    destruct Hs0 as (_ & HU & _).
    pose proof (mdesc_entry_closed _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HU He) as (-> & _ & _).
    assert (Hlt : Θ = nil -> List.length Ns < List.length T).
    { intros ->; cbn in HT0; destruct (Nat.leb (List.length Ns) (List.length T)) eqn:Hle; [| discriminate ].
      injection HT0 as <-; apply Nat.leb_le in Hle.
      destruct (Nat.eq_dec (List.length Ns) (List.length T)) as [Heq |]; [| lia ].
      exfalso; rewrite Heq, Nat.sub_diag in HvT; cbn in HvT; discriminate. }
    destruct (sel_at_closed _ _ Hc _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hco HTa HU HΘa Hlt He Hed Hrd HRsel Hat)
      as (R0m'' & rd' & HR0m'' & He' & Rs'' & Hrd' & HRs'').
    rewrite HR0m' in HR0m''; injection HR0m'' as <-.
    exists Rs''; split; [| rewrite HRs''; exact HRm1 ].
    eapply mdenote_mem; [ exact HmX | exact HmR0' | exact He' | | exact Hrd' ].
    cbn [mdesc_at] in HR0m'; destruct (tele_split (rev Θ)) as [[[? ?] ?] | ?]; injection HR0m' as <-; exact Hed.
Qed.

A closed module at arguments still lacking a parameter: the stored telescope split at the arguments, the rest instantiated by them being its telescope.
Lemma closed_tele_split : forall Θ p T Φ Ns T0 B0 T10,
    mdesc_tele (mdesc_closed Θ p T Φ Ns) = Some T0 -> tele_view T0 = Some (B0, T10) -> Θ = nil ->
    List.length Ns < List.length T /\
    T0 = tele_sub (List.firstn (List.length T - List.length Ns) T) (sb_of_list Id Ns).
Proof.
  intros * HT Hv ->; cbn in HT.
  destruct (Nat.leb (List.length Ns) (List.length T)) eqn:Hle; [| discriminate ].
  injection HT as <-; apply Nat.leb_le in Hle; rewrite app_nil_r in Hv |- *.
  split; [| reflexivity ].
  destruct (Nat.eq_dec (List.length Ns) (List.length T)) as [Heq |]; [| lia ].
  exfalso; rewrite Heq, Nat.sub_diag in Hv; cbn in Hv; discriminate.
Qed.

A closed module description over a stored telescope extending T by Δ, given the arguments Ns for the outermost parameters of T: its telescope ends in the rest of T instantiated by them.
Lemma closed_ext_tele : forall pq Δ T Φ Ns k,
    k = List.length T - List.length Ns -> List.length Ns < List.length T ->
    exists Z, mdesc_tele (mdesc_closed nil pq (Δ ++ T) Φ Ns) =
      Some (Z ++ tele_sub (List.firstn k T) (sb_of_list Id Ns)).
Proof.
  intros * -> Hlt; cbn [mdesc_tele].
  rewrite length_app; replace (Nat.leb (List.length Ns) (List.length Δ + List.length T)) with true
    by (symmetry; apply Nat.leb_le; lia).
  replace (List.length Δ + List.length T - List.length Ns) with (List.length Δ + (List.length T - List.length Ns)) by lia.
  rewrite firstn_app_2, tele_sub_app, app_nil_r; eexists; reflexivity.
Qed.

The outermost parameter of a selection from a module lacking one is the module's: the selection's telescope extends the module's, the module's outside parameters, or, at a closed module given arguments, the rest of its stored telescope instantiated by them, which every stored entry with a module part extends (gm_coherent).
Lemma sel_view : forall Γ X y R0 R0m T0 B0 T10 Rsel T',
    gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵐ X ≈ X -> names_no_frame (me_mem X y) ->
    mdenote gc_deps gc_stack Γ X R0 -> mdesc_mod R0 = Some R0m -> mdesc_tele R0m = Some T0 ->
    tele_view T0 = Some (B0, T10) ->
    mdenote gc_deps gc_stack Γ (me_mem X y) Rsel -> mdesc_mod_tele Rsel = Some T' ->
    exists T1', tele_view T' = Some (B0, T1').
Proof.
  intros * HH Hq Hm0 HR0m HT0 Hv Hsel HT'.
  pose proof (presup_modexp_eq_ctx HH) as HwΓ.
  pose proof (ctx_wf_gctx _ _ _ HwΓ) as Hg.
  apply (mdenote_mem_no_frame _ _ _ _ _ Hg Hq Hsel); intros R0' R0m' Γy E rd R Hm0' HR0m' He Hed Hrd.
  rewrite (proj1 (mdenote_functional_all _ _ Hg) _ _ _ Hm0' _ Hm0), HR0m in HR0m'; injection HR0m' as <-.
  pose proof (desc_ok_mod _ _ Hg _ _ _ (me_desc_ok _ _ _ _ _ _ HH Hm0) HR0m) as Hok.
  pose proof (mdesc_mod_scoped _ _ _ (wf_mdenote_scoped _ _ _ _ _ _ HH Hm0) HR0m) as Hs0.
  pose proof (mdesc_mod_is_mod _ _ HR0m) as HisR0m.
  destruct R0m as [| Δ Φw Φx | Θ p T Φ Ns |]; cbn in HisR0m; try contradiction.
  -
An open module: the selection is abstracted over its parameters
    cbn in HT0; injection HT0 as <-.
    cbn in He; destruct (gm_prefix_upto Φx y) as [[| Φ' z E0 | ] |]; try discriminate.
    destruct E0 as [[|] ? ? ? [] | | | |]; try discriminate; injection He as <- <- <-;
      cbn [mdesc_read] in Hrd; destruct (gm_fill Φ'); cbn [option_map] in Hrd; try discriminate; injection Hrd as <-;
      destruct (mdesc_mod_tele_up_inv _ _ _ HT') as (T0' & ->); exact (tele_view_app_r _ _ _ _ Hv).
  - pose proof (mdesc_entry_closed _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ (proj1 (proj2 Hs0)) He) as (-> & HsE & ->).
    cbn [mdesc_read] in Hrd; destruct (mdesc_ats_read R Ns) as [R1 |] eqn:Hats; cbn [option_map] in Hrd; [| discriminate ].
    injection Hrd as <-.
    inversion Hok; subst.
    match goal with H : all_assumptions Θ |- _ => rename H into HΘa end.
    match goal with H : all_assumptions T |- _ => rename H into HTa end.
    destruct Θ as [| e Θr _] using rev_ind.
    +
No outside parameter: the stored entry extends the stored telescope
      destruct (closed_tele_split _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HT0 Hv eq_refl) as (Hlt & ->).
      rewrite mdesc_up_nil in HT'; unfold mdesc_mod_tele in HT'; rewrite mdesc_mod_named in HT'.
      match goal with H : ⊢ᵍ ?Θ0 ⍮ ?Ξ0, Hl : loc ?Θ0 ?Ξ0 p T Φ, Hsub : gc_sub ?Θ0 ?Ξ0 _ _ |- _ =>
        rename H into Hg0; rename Hl into Hloc; rename Hsub into Hgs end.
      pose proof (loc_coherent _ _ Hg0 _ _ _ Hloc) as Hco.
      destruct Hs0 as (_ & [_ HbΦ] & _).
      pose proof He as He0; cbn in He0.
      destruct (gm_prefix_upto Φ y) as [[| Φ0 z E0 | ] |] eqn:Hp; try discriminate.
      injection He0 as <-.
      destruct (gm_prefix_entry _ _ _ Hp) as (? & ? & Heq & Hent); injection Heq as <- -> <-.
      pose proof (gm_coherent_prefix _ _ _ _ _ Hco Hp) as HcoE.
      cbn [mdesc_entry_path] in Hed.
      set (k := List.length T - List.length Ns) in *.
The stored telescope split at the arguments
      assert (HTs : T = List.firstn k T ++ List.skipn k T) by (symmetry; apply firstn_skipn).
      assert (Hlk : List.length (List.skipn k T) = List.length Ns) by (rewrite length_skipn; unfold k; lia).
      assert (Hak : all_assumptions (List.skipn k T))
        by (pose proof HTa as Ha; rewrite HTs in Ha; unfold all_assumptions in Ha; apply Forall_app in Ha as [_ Ha]; exact Ha).
A module part abstracted over the stored telescope extended, given the arguments, ends in the rest instantiated
      assert (Hup : forall Δ0 R' Rx, mdesc_is_mod R' -> mdesc_ats (mdesc_up (Δ0 ++ T) R') Ns = Some Rx ->
                 mdesc_tele Rx = Some T' -> exists Z, T' = Z ++ tele_sub (List.firstn k T) (sb_of_list Id Ns)).
      { intros * HR' Hx HTx.
        rewrite HTs, app_assoc, (mdesc_ats_up_prefix _ _ _ _ Hak Hlk) in Hx; injection Hx as <-.
        destruct (mdesc_tele_up_inv _ _ _ (mdesc_is_mod_sub _ _ HR') HTx) as (T0' & ->).
        rewrite tele_sub_app, app_assoc; eexists; reflexivity. }
      
A closed module over the stored telescope extended, given the arguments
      assert (Hcl : forall pq Δ Φq, mdesc_tele (mdesc_closed nil pq (Δ ++ T) Φq Ns) = Some T' ->
                 exists Z, T' = Z ++ tele_sub (List.firstn k T) (sb_of_list Id Ns)).
      { intros * HTx; destruct (closed_ext_tele pq Δ T Φq Ns k eq_refl Hlt) as (Z & HZ).
        rewrite HZ in HTx; injection HTx as <-; eauto. }
      assert (Hext : exists Z, T' = Z ++ tele_sub (List.firstn k T) (sb_of_list Id Ns)).
      { destruct E0 as [b pv κ A M | pv [Δ [sm Φy | Ea]] | pv pq k' D ΦD | pv A M U | pv pr Rr ΦR];
          cbn [ge_read] in Hed.
        -
a definition has no module part
          inversion Hed; subst; cbn [mdesc_ats_read] in Hats.
          destruct (mdesc_ats_term _ _ _ _ _ Hats) as (? & ? & ->); discriminate.
        -
a body submodule, stored closed
          pose proof (body_closed_entry_mod _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HbΦ Hent) as ->.
          inversion Hed; subst.
          match goal with Hu : udenote _ _ _ _ _ _ |- _ => inversion Hu; subst end.
          match goal with Hb : mdesc_body _ _ _ _ _ = Some _ |- _ => cbn in Hb; injection Hb as <- end.
          cbn [mdesc_ats_read] in Hats; rewrite mdesc_ats_closed_nil in Hats; injection Hats as <-.
          cbn [mdesc_mod] in HT'; exact (Hcl _ _ _ HT').
        -
an alias, over the stored telescope extended
          cbn [ge_coherent] in HcoE; destruct HcoE as (Δ0 & -> & _).
          inversion Hed; subst.
          match goal with Hu : udenote _ _ _ _ _ _ |- _ => inversion Hu; subst end.
          match goal with Hmd : mdesc_mod ?RE = Some ?R' |- _ => pose proof (mdesc_mod_is_mod _ _ Hmd) as HR' end.
          rewrite (mdesc_ats_read_mod _ _ (mdesc_is_mod_up _ _ HR')) in Hats.
          assert (HR1 : mdesc_is_mod R1) by (eapply mdesc_ats_is_mod; [ apply mdesc_is_mod_up; exact HR' | exact Hats ]).
          rewrite (mdesc_is_mod_mod _ HR1) in HT'.
          exact (Hup _ _ _ HR' Hats HT').
        -
a type former of a group: its module, filed below
          cbn [ge_coherent] in HcoE; destruct HcoE as [(Δ0 & HuD & _) _].
          inversion Hed; subst.
          pose proof (gc_entry_selfpath _ _ Hg0 _ _ _ _ _ _ (proj2 (loc_entry _ _ Hg0 _ _ _ Hloc _ _) Hent)) as Hsp.
          match goal with Hpm : ind_mpath _ _ = Some ?pm, Hlm : gc_loc _ _ ?pm = Some _ |- _ =>
            rewrite (ind_selfpath_path _ _ _ _ Hsp) in Hpm; injection Hpm as <-;
            pose proof (gc_sub_body_eq _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hgs (loc_child_ind _ _ Hg0 _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hloc Hent)) as Hb';
            unfold gc_loc in Hlm; rewrite (gc_body_not_frame _ _ _ _ Hb'), Hb' in Hlm; injection Hlm as <- <- end.
          unfold ind_former_desc in Hats; cbn [mdesc_ats_read] in Hats.
          destruct (mdesc_term_part_ats _ Ns) as [[? ? [?|] | | |] |]; try discriminate.
          rewrite mdesc_ats_closed_nil in Hats; injection Hats as <-.
          cbn [mdesc_mod] in HT'; rewrite HuD in HT'; exact (Hcl _ _ _ HT').
        -
a definition with a module part: its module part, an alias
          cbn [ge_coherent] in HcoE; destruct HcoE as [_ (Δ0 & Ea & -> & _)].
          inversion Hed; subst.
          match goal with Hu : udenote _ _ _ _ _ _ |- _ => inversion Hu; subst end.
          match goal with Hmd : mdesc_mod ?RE = Some ?R' |- _ => pose proof (mdesc_mod_is_mod _ _ Hmd) as HR' end.
          cbn [mdesc_ats_read] in Hats.
          destruct (mdesc_term_part_ats _ Ns) as [[? ? [?|] | | |] |]; try discriminate.
          destruct (mdesc_ats (mdesc_up (Δ0 ++ T) _) Ns) as [Rx |] eqn:Hx; [ injection Hats as <- | discriminate ].
          cbn [mdesc_mod] in HT'.
          assert (HRx : mdesc_is_mod Rx) by (eapply mdesc_ats_is_mod; [ apply mdesc_is_mod_up; exact HR' | exact Hx ]).
          rewrite (mdesc_is_mod_mod _ HRx) in HT'.
          exact (Hup _ _ _ HR' Hx HT').
        -
a record type: its module, filed below
          cbn [ge_coherent] in HcoE; destruct HcoE as [(Δ0 & HpR & HΔ0) _].
          inversion Hed; subst.
          match goal with Hlm : gc_loc _ _ (qname_in p y) = Some _ |- _ =>
            pose proof (gc_sub_body_eq _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hgs (loc_child_record _ _ Hg0 _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hloc Hent)) as Hb';
            unfold gc_loc in Hlm; rewrite (gc_body_not_frame _ _ _ _ Hb'), Hb' in Hlm; injection Hlm as <- <- end.
          unfold record_former_desc in Hats; cbn [mdesc_ats_read] in Hats.
          destruct (mdesc_term_part_ats _ Ns) as [[? ? [?|] | | |] |]; try discriminate.
          rewrite mdesc_ats_closed_nil in Hats; injection Hats as <-.
          cbn [mdesc_mod] in HT'.
          destruct (record_mod_tele_split pr Rr _ _ HpR HΔ0) as (Hrt & _); rewrite Hrt in HT'.
          exact (Hcl _ _ _ HT'). }
      destruct Hext as (Z & ->).
      exact (tele_view_app_r _ _ _ _ Hv).
    +
The outermost outside parameter
      unfold all_assumptions in HΘa; apply Forall_app in HΘa as [_ He1]; apply Forall_cons_iff in He1 as [(κ & B & ->) _].
      destruct (mdesc_mod_tele_up_inv _ _ _ HT') as (T0' & ->).
      cbn [mdesc_tele] in HT0.
      destruct (Nat.leb (List.length Ns) (List.length T)); [ injection HT0 as <- | discriminate ].
      rewrite app_assoc, tele_view_last in Hv; injection Hv as <- _.
      rewrite app_assoc, tele_view_last; eexists; reflexivity.
Qed.

A typed module expression whose telescope has an outermost parameter has one at every typed substitution.
Lemma tele_view_under_sub : forall Γ X,
    gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵐ X ≈ X ->
    (forall R0 T0, mdenote gc_deps gc_stack Γ X R0 -> mdesc_mod_tele R0 = Some T0 -> exists B T1, tele_view T0 = Some (B, T1)) ->
    forall Γ' ζ, Γ' ⊢ˢ ζ : Γ ->
    forall R0 T0, mdenote gc_deps gc_stack Γ' X[ζ]ᵐ R0 -> mdesc_mod_tele R0 = Some T0 -> exists B T1, tele_view T0 = Some (B, T1).
Proof.
  intros * HH Hv * Hζ * Hm HT.
  destruct (me_mod_tele_exists HH) as (RX & TX & HmX & HTX).
  destruct (Hv _ _ HmX HTX) as (B & T1 & HvX).
  pose proof (wf_sub_mdenote _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HH HmX Hζ) as HmXζ.
  pose proof (ctx_wf_gctx _ _ _ (wf_sub_dom _ _ _ _ _ Hζ)) as Hg.
  rewrite (proj1 (mdenote_functional_all _ _ Hg) _ _ _ Hm _ HmXζ) in HT.
  rewrite (mdesc_mod_tele_sub _ _ ζ _ (wf_mdenote_scoped _ _ _ _ _ _ HH HmX) HTX) in HT; injection HT as <-.
  rewrite tele_view_sub, HvX; cbn; eauto.
Qed.

The selection from X applied to N and the selection from X given N have the same module part both ways, when X has a next parameter and names no open frame at any substitution, the former being typed (mdenote_mem_app_of_app_mem).
Lemma same_part_app_mem : forall Γ X y N,
    gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵐ X ≈ X ->
    gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵐ me_app (me_mem X y) N ≈ me_app (me_mem X y) N ->
    (forall Γ' ζ, Γ' ⊢ˢ ζ : Γ -> names_no_frame (me_mem X y)[ζ]ᵐ) ->
    (forall R0 T0, mdenote gc_deps gc_stack Γ X R0 -> mdesc_mod_tele R0 = Some T0 -> exists B T1, tele_view T0 = Some (B, T1)) ->
    same_part Γ (me_mem (me_app X N) y) (me_app (me_mem X y) N) /\ same_part Γ (me_app (me_mem X y) N) (me_mem (me_app X N) y).
Proof.
  intros * HX HK Hq Hv; split; intros Γ' ζ R Rm Hζ Hm HRm; cbn [modexp_sub] in Hm |- *.
  -
The application of the selection denotes, typed; so does the selection from the application, alike
    pose proof (sub_preserves_modexp _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HK Hζ) as HKζ; cbn [modexp_sub] in HKζ.
    destruct (me_denotes _ _ _ _ _ HKζ) as (R1 & Rm1 & Hm1 & HRm1).
    destruct (mdenote_mem_app_of_app_mem _ _ _ _ _ _ (sub_preserves_modexp _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HX Hζ) (Hq _ _ Hζ)
                (tele_view_under_sub _ _ HX Hv _ _ Hζ) Hm1 HRm1) as (R2 & Hm2 & HRm2).
    pose proof (ctx_wf_gctx _ _ _ (wf_sub_dom _ _ _ _ _ Hζ)) as Hg.
    rewrite (proj1 (mdenote_functional_all _ _ Hg) _ _ _ Hm2 _ Hm) in HRm2.
    exists R1; split; [ exact Hm1 | congruence ].
  - exact (mdenote_mem_app_of_app_mem _ _ _ _ _ _ (sub_preserves_modexp _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HX Hζ) (Hq _ _ Hζ)
             (tele_view_under_sub _ _ HX Hv _ _ Hζ) Hm HRm).
Qed.

A stored alias submodule is the module at its path, an alias.
Lemma gm_entry_alias_submodule : forall Φ T x ip pv Δ E,
    gm_entry Φ (x :: ip) = Some (ge_mod pv (gu_mk Δ (md_alias E))) ->
    gm_submodule T Φ x ip = Some (mr_alias (gu_mk Δ (md_alias E))).
Proof.
  fix IH 1; intros [| Φ y E0 | Φ H its] T x ip *; cbn; try discriminate; intros He; try (eapply IH; exact He).
  destruct (String.eqb x y); [| eapply IH; exact He ].
  destruct ip as [| z ip], E0 as [b' pv' A' B' | pm0 [Δ0 [? Φ1 | E']] | pv' ? ? D' Φ1 | pv' A1 M1 [Δ1 [? Φ1 | E1]] | pv' Rr Φ1];
    cbn in He |- *; try discriminate; try (injection He as -> -> -> ; reflexivity); eapply IH; exact He.
Qed.

A body submodule selected from a stored module at arguments, as a module: the stored module at the submodule's path, at the same arguments, whose telescope extends the parent's.
Lemma global_sel_desc : ⊢ᵍ gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack -> forall Γ H y R0 p T Φ Ns1 Rsel Rm T' Φ',
    names_no_frame (me_mem H y) -> mdenote gc_deps gc_stack Γ H R0 -> mdesc_mod R0 = Some (mdesc_closed nil p T Φ Ns1) ->
    gc_loc gc_deps gc_stack p = Some (T, Φ) ->
    mdenote gc_deps gc_stack Γ (me_mem H y) Rsel -> mdesc_mod Rsel = Some Rm ->
    gc_loc gc_deps gc_stack (qname_in p y) = Some (T', Φ') ->
    Rm = mdesc_closed nil (qname_in p y) T' Φ' Ns1 /\ exists Z, T' = Z ++ T.
Proof.
  intros Hgw * Hq Hm0 HR0m Hl Hsel HRm Hl'.
  pose proof (wf_gstack_closed _ _ Hgw) as Hc.
  apply (mdenote_mem_no_frame _ _ _ _ _ Hgw Hq Hsel); intros R0' R0m' Γy E rd R Hm0' HR0m' He Hed Hrd.
  rewrite (proj1 (mdenote_functional_all _ _ Hgw) _ _ _ Hm0' _ Hm0), HR0m in HR0m'; injection HR0m' as <-.
  pose proof (gc_loc_closed _ _ _ _ _ Hc Hl) as HU.
  pose proof (gc_loc_loc _ _ _ _ _ Hl) as Hloc.
  pose proof (loc_coherent _ _ Hgw _ _ _ Hloc) as Hco.
  pose proof (mdesc_entry_closed _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HU He) as (-> & _ & ->).
  pose proof He as He0; cbn in He0.
  destruct (gm_prefix_upto Φ y) as [[| Φ0 z E0 | ] |] eqn:Hp; try discriminate.
  injection He0 as <-.
  destruct (gm_prefix_entry _ _ _ Hp) as (? & ? & Heq & Hent); injection Heq as <- -> <-.
  pose proof (gm_coherent_prefix _ _ _ _ _ Hco Hp) as HcoE.
  destruct (gm_entry_head _ _ _ Hent) as (z & ip & [= <- <-] & Hin).
  destruct (loc_read _ _ Hgw _ _ _ Hloc _ Hin nil) as (_ & _ & Hmod & _).
  rewrite <- qname_in_app in Hmod.
  cbn [mdesc_entry_path] in Hed.
  cbn [mdesc_read] in Hrd; destruct (mdesc_ats_read R Ns1) as [R1 |] eqn:Hats; cbn [option_map] in Hrd; [| discriminate ].
  injection Hrd as <-.
  rewrite mdesc_up_nil, mdesc_mod_named in HRm.
  destruct HU as [_ HbΦ].
  destruct E0 as [b pv κ A M | pv [Δ [sm Φy | Ea]] | pv pq k' D ΦD | pv A M U | pv pr Rr ΦR]; cbn [ge_read] in Hed.
  -
a definition has no module part
    inversion Hed; subst; cbn [mdesc_ats_read] in Hats.
    destruct (mdesc_ats_term _ _ _ _ _ Hats) as (? & ? & ->); discriminate.
  -
a body submodule
    pose proof (body_closed_entry_mod _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HbΦ Hent) as ->.
    destruct (loc_child_mod _ _ Hgw _ _ _ Hloc _ _ _ _ _ Hent) as [Hb' _].
    unfold gc_loc in Hl'; rewrite (gc_body_not_frame _ _ _ _ Hb'), Hb' in Hl'; injection Hl' as <- <-.
    destruct (gm_entry_closed _ _ _ _ HbΦ Hent) as (k & _ & _ & Hck).
    pose proof (body_closed_noopen _ _ Hck) as Hno.
    inversion Hed; subst.
    match goal with Hu : udenote _ _ _ _ _ _ |- _ => inversion Hu; subst end.
    match goal with Hx : body_xp _ _ _ Φy ?Φx, Hd : mdesc_body _ _ _ _ _ = Some _ |- _ =>
      rewrite (body_xp_noopen_id _ _ _ _ _ Hno Hx) in Hd; cbn in Hd; injection Hd as <- end.
    cbn [mdesc_ats_read] in Hats; rewrite mdesc_ats_closed_nil in Hats; injection Hats as <-.
    cbn [mdesc_mod] in HRm; injection HRm as <-; split; [ reflexivity | eauto ].
  -
an alias is no stored body
    exfalso; rewrite (gm_entry_alias_submodule _ T _ _ _ _ _ Hent) in Hmod.
    exact (gc_loc_not_alias _ _ _ _ _ Hl' Hmod).
  -
a type former of a group: its module, at its path
    cbn [ge_coherent] in HcoE; destruct HcoE as [(Δ0 & HuD & _) _].
    inversion Hed; subst.
    pose proof (gc_entry_selfpath _ _ Hgw _ _ _ _ _ _ (proj2 (loc_entry _ _ Hgw _ _ _ Hloc _ _) Hent)) as Hsp.
    match goal with Hpm : ind_mpath _ _ = Some ?pm, Hlm : gc_loc _ _ ?pm = Some _ |- _ =>
      rewrite (ind_selfpath_path _ _ _ _ Hsp) in Hpm; injection Hpm as <-; rewrite Hl' in Hlm; injection Hlm as <- <- end.
    pose proof (loc_child_ind _ _ Hgw _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hloc Hent) as Hb'.
    unfold gc_loc in Hl'; rewrite (gc_body_not_frame _ _ _ _ Hb'), Hb' in Hl'; injection Hl' as <- <-.
    unfold ind_former_desc in Hats; cbn [mdesc_ats_read] in Hats.
    destruct (mdesc_term_part_ats _ Ns1) as [[? ? [?|] | | |] |]; try discriminate.
    rewrite mdesc_ats_closed_nil in Hats; injection Hats as <-.
    cbn [mdesc_mod] in HRm; injection HRm as <-; split; [ reflexivity | eauto ].
  -
a definition with a module part is no stored body
    exfalso; cbn [ge_coherent] in HcoE; destruct HcoE as [_ (Δ0 & Ea & -> & _)].
    rewrite (gm_entry_def_mod_submodule _ T _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hent) in Hmod.
    exact (gc_loc_not_alias _ _ _ _ _ Hl' Hmod).
  -
a record type: its module, at its path
    cbn [ge_coherent] in HcoE; destruct HcoE as [(Δ0 & HpR & HΔ0) _].
    inversion Hed; subst.
    match goal with Hlm : gc_loc _ _ (qname_in p y) = Some _ |- _ => rewrite Hl' in Hlm; injection Hlm as <- <- end.
    pose proof (loc_child_record _ _ Hgw _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hloc Hent) as Hb'.
    unfold gc_loc in Hl'; rewrite (gc_body_not_frame _ _ _ _ Hb'), Hb' in Hl'; injection Hl' as <- <-.
    unfold record_former_desc in Hats; cbn [mdesc_ats_read] in Hats.
    destruct (mdesc_term_part_ats _ Ns1) as [[? ? [?|] | | |] |]; try discriminate.
    rewrite mdesc_ats_closed_nil in Hats; injection Hats as <-.
    cbn [mdesc_mod] in HRm; injection HRm as <-; split; [ reflexivity |].
    destruct (record_mod_tele_split pr Rr _ _ HpR HΔ0) as (-> & _); eauto.
Qed.

An alias submodule selected from a stored module at all its arguments, as a module: the module part of the alias's target, abstracted over the alias's own parameters, the stored telescope instantiated by the arguments (mdesc_ats_up_prefix).
Lemma global_sel_alias_desc : ⊢ᵍ gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack -> forall Γ H y R0 p T Φ Ns1 Rsel Rm Δa Da,
    names_no_frame (me_mem H y) -> mdenote gc_deps gc_stack Γ H R0 -> mdesc_mod R0 = Some (mdesc_closed nil p T Φ Ns1) ->
    gc_loc gc_deps gc_stack p = Some (T, Φ) -> List.length Ns1 = List.length T ->
    mdenote gc_deps gc_stack Γ (me_mem H y) Rsel -> mdesc_mod Rsel = Some Rm ->
    gc_module gc_deps gc_stack (qname_in p y) = Some (mr_alias (gu_mk Δa Da)) ->
    exists E Δ0 RE RmE, Da = md_alias E /\ Δa = Δ0 ++ T /\ gunit_scoped 0 (gu_mk Δa Da) /\
      mdenote gc_deps gc_stack (Δa ++ nil ++ Γ) E RE /\ mdesc_mod RE = Some RmE /\
      Rm = mdesc_up (tele_sub Δ0 (sb_of_list Id Ns1)) (mdesc_sub RmE (sb_qn (List.length Δ0) (sb_of_list Id Ns1))).
Proof.
  intros Hgw * Hq Hm0 HR0m Hl Hlen Hsel HRm Hmod'.
  pose proof (wf_gstack_closed _ _ Hgw) as Hc.
  apply (mdenote_mem_no_frame _ _ _ _ _ Hgw Hq Hsel); intros R0' R0m' Γy E' rd R Hm0' HR0m' He Hed Hrd.
  rewrite (proj1 (mdenote_functional_all _ _ Hgw) _ _ _ Hm0' _ Hm0), HR0m in HR0m'; injection HR0m' as <-.
  pose proof (gc_loc_closed _ _ _ _ _ Hc Hl) as HU.
  pose proof (gc_loc_loc _ _ _ _ _ Hl) as Hloc.
  pose proof (loc_coherent _ _ Hgw _ _ _ Hloc) as Hco.
  pose proof (mdesc_entry_closed _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HU He) as (-> & _ & ->).
  pose proof He as He0; cbn in He0.
  destruct (gm_prefix_upto Φ y) as [[| Φ0 z E0 | ] |] eqn:Hp; try discriminate.
  injection He0 as <-.
  destruct (gm_prefix_entry _ _ _ Hp) as (? & ? & Heq & Hent); injection Heq as <- -> <-.
  pose proof (gm_coherent_prefix _ _ _ _ _ Hco Hp) as HcoE.
  destruct (gm_entry_head _ _ _ Hent) as (z & ip & [= <- <-] & Hin).
  destruct (loc_read _ _ Hgw _ _ _ Hloc _ Hin nil) as (_ & _ & Hmod & _).
  rewrite <- qname_in_app in Hmod; rewrite Hmod' in Hmod.
  cbn [mdesc_entry_path] in Hed.
  cbn [mdesc_read] in Hrd; destruct (mdesc_ats_read R Ns1) as [R1 |] eqn:Hats; cbn [option_map] in Hrd; [| discriminate ].
  injection Hrd as <-.
  rewrite mdesc_up_nil, mdesc_mod_named in HRm.
  destruct HU as [_ HbΦ].
The stored body's arguments split nothing off the stored telescope
  assert (HupT : forall Δ0 R', mdesc_is_mod R' ->
            mdesc_ats (mdesc_up (Δ0 ++ T) R') Ns1 =
              Some (mdesc_up (tele_sub Δ0 (sb_of_list Id Ns1)) (mdesc_sub R' (sb_qn (List.length Δ0) (sb_of_list Id Ns1))))).
  { intros * _; apply mdesc_ats_up_prefix; [ exact (gc_loc_tele_all_assumptions _ _ Hgw _ _ _ Hl) | lia ]. }
  destruct E0 as [b pv κ A M | pv [Δ [sm Φy | Ea]] | pv pq k' D ΦD | pv A M U | pv pr Rr ΦR]; cbn [ge_read] in Hed.
  -
a definition has no module part
    exfalso; inversion Hed; subst; cbn [mdesc_ats_read] in Hats.
    destruct (mdesc_ats_term _ _ _ _ _ Hats) as (? & ? & ->); discriminate.
  -
a body submodule is no alias
    exfalso; destruct (loc_child_mod _ _ Hgw _ _ _ Hloc _ _ _ _ _ Hent) as [_ Hb]; rewrite Hb in Hmod'; discriminate.
  -
an alias
    rewrite (gm_entry_alias_submodule _ T _ _ _ _ _ Hent) in Hmod; injection Hmod as -> ->.
    cbn [ge_coherent] in HcoE; destruct HcoE as (Δ0 & -> & _).
    inversion Hed; subst.
    match goal with Hu : udenote _ _ _ _ _ _ |- _ => inversion Hu; subst end.
    match goal with HmE : mdenote _ _ _ ?E1 ?RE, Hmd : mdesc_mod ?RE = Some ?RmE |- _ =>
      pose proof (mdesc_mod_is_mod _ _ Hmd) as HRmE;
      rewrite (mdesc_ats_read_mod _ _ (mdesc_is_mod_up _ _ HRmE)), (HupT _ _ HRmE) in Hats; injection Hats as <-;
      rewrite (mdesc_is_mod_mod _ (mdesc_is_mod_up _ _ (mdesc_is_mod_sub _ _ HRmE))) in HRm; injection HRm as <-;
      pose proof (entry_alias_unit_scoped _ _ _ _ _ _ 0 HbΦ Hp eq_refl) as HsU;
      eexists; exists Δ0, RE, RmE; split; [ reflexivity | split; [ reflexivity | split; [ exact HsU | repeat split; first [ reflexivity | assumption ] ] ] ] end.
  -
a type former's module is no alias
    exfalso; pose proof (loc_child_ind _ _ Hgw _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hloc Hent) as Hb.
    assert (Hl' : gc_loc gc_deps gc_stack (qname_in p y) = Some (ind_uparams D, ΦD))
      by (unfold gc_loc; rewrite (gc_body_not_frame _ _ _ _ Hb), Hb; reflexivity).
    exact (gc_loc_not_alias _ _ _ _ _ Hl' Hmod').
  -
a definition with a module part: its module part, an alias
    cbn [ge_coherent] in HcoE; destruct HcoE as [_ (Δ0 & Ea & -> & _)].
    rewrite (gm_entry_def_mod_submodule _ T _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hent) in Hmod; injection Hmod as -> ->.
    inversion Hed; subst.
    match goal with Hu : udenote _ _ _ _ _ _ |- _ => inversion Hu; subst end.
    match goal with HmE : mdenote _ _ _ ?E1 ?RE, Hmd : mdesc_mod ?RE = Some ?RmE |- _ =>
      pose proof (mdesc_mod_is_mod _ _ Hmd) as HRmE;
      cbn [mdesc_ats_read] in Hats; rewrite (HupT _ _ HRmE) in Hats;
      destruct (mdesc_term_part_ats _ Ns1) as [[? ? [?|] | | |] |]; try discriminate; injection Hats as <-;
      cbn [mdesc_mod] in HRm;
      rewrite (mdesc_is_mod_mod _ (mdesc_is_mod_up _ _ (mdesc_is_mod_sub _ _ HRmE))) in HRm; injection HRm as <-;
      pose proof (entry_alias_unit_scoped _ _ _ _ _ _ 0 HbΦ Hp eq_refl) as HsU;
      eexists; exists Δ0, RE, RmE; split; [ reflexivity | split; [ reflexivity | split; [ exact HsU | repeat split; first [ reflexivity | assumption ] ] ] ] end.
  -
a record type's module is no alias
    exfalso; pose proof (loc_child_record _ _ Hgw _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hloc Hent) as Hb.
    assert (Hl' : gc_loc gc_deps gc_stack (qname_in p y) = Some (record_mod_tele pr Rr, ΦR))
      by (unfold gc_loc; rewrite (gc_body_not_frame _ _ _ _ Hb), Hb; reflexivity).
    exact (gc_loc_not_alias _ _ _ _ _ Hl' Hmod').
Qed.

The rest of a telescope past some arguments, instantiated by them, ends in the next parameter instantiated.
Lemma tele_rest_view : forall T Ns κ A, List.length Ns < List.length T ->
    List.nth_error (List.rev T) (List.length Ns) = Some (ce_ass κ A) ->
    exists T1, tele_sub (List.firstn (List.length T - List.length Ns) T) (sb_of_list Id Ns) =
      tele_sub T1 (q (sb_of_list Id Ns)) ++ ce_ass κ A[sb_of_list Id Ns] :: nil.
Proof.
  intros * Hlt Hnth.
  pose proof (List.nth_error_split _ _ Hnth) as (l1 & l2 & Erev & Hl1).
  assert (ET : T = List.rev l2 ++ ce_ass κ A :: List.rev l1)
    by (rewrite <- (List.rev_involutive T), Erev, List.rev_app_distr; cbn; rewrite <- List.app_assoc; reflexivity).
  exists (List.rev l2).
  assert (Hfn : List.firstn (List.length T - List.length Ns) T = List.rev l2 ++ ce_ass κ A :: nil).
  { rewrite ET, List.length_app; cbn [List.length]; rewrite !List.length_rev, Hl1.
    replace (List.length l2 + S (List.length Ns) - List.length Ns) with (List.length (List.rev l2) + 1) by (rewrite List.length_rev; lia).
    rewrite List.firstn_app, List.firstn_all2 by lia.
    replace (List.length (List.rev l2) + 1 - List.length (List.rev l2)) with 1 by lia; reflexivity. }
  rewrite Hfn, tele_sub_app; reflexivity.
Qed.

A literal alias over the stored telescope extended, given arguments for some of the stored telescope's parameters: its target's module part, abstracted over the rest instantiated.
Lemma lit_alias_apps_desc : forall Γ Δ0 T E Ms R,
    all_assumptions T -> List.length Ms <= List.length T ->
    mdenote gc_deps gc_stack Γ (me_apps (me_lit (gu_mk (Δ0 ++ T) (md_alias E))) Ms) R ->
    exists RE RmE, mdenote gc_deps gc_stack ((Δ0 ++ T) ++ Γ) E RE /\ mdesc_mod RE = Some RmE /\
      R = mdesc_up (tele_sub (Δ0 ++ List.firstn (List.length T - List.length Ms) T) (sb_of_list Id Ms))
            (mdesc_sub RmE (sb_qn (List.length Δ0 + (List.length T - List.length Ms)) (sb_of_list Id Ms))).
Proof.
  intros * HTa Hle Hm.
  destruct (mdenote_apps_inv _ _ _ _ _ _ Hm) as (R0 & Hm0 & Hats).
  apply mdenote_lit_inv in Hm0.
  inversion Hm0; subst.
  match goal with HmE : mdenote _ _ _ E ?RE, Hmd : mdesc_mod ?RE = Some ?RmE |- _ => exists RE, RmE; split; [ exact HmE | split; [ exact Hmd |] ] end.
  set (k := List.length T - List.length Ms) in *.
  assert (HTs : T = List.firstn k T ++ List.skipn k T) by (symmetry; apply firstn_skipn).
  assert (Hlk : List.length (List.skipn k T) = List.length Ms) by (rewrite length_skipn; unfold k; lia).
  assert (Hak : all_assumptions (List.skipn k T))
    by (pose proof HTa as Ha; rewrite HTs in Ha; unfold all_assumptions in Ha; apply Forall_app in Ha as [_ Ha]; exact Ha).
  rewrite HTs, app_assoc, (mdesc_ats_up_prefix _ _ _ _ Hak Hlk) in Hats; injection Hats as <-.
  rewrite length_app, firstn_length_le by (unfold k; lia); reflexivity.
Qed.

The first arguments of glued arguments are glued.
Lemma glu_tele_args_prefix : forall Δ ts ρ Ms Ns args, glu_tele_args Δ ts ρ Ms Ns args ->
    forall k, glu_tele_args Δ ts ρ Ms (List.firstn k Ns) (List.firstn k args).
Proof.
  induction 1; intros [| k]; cbn [List.firstn]; try constructor.
  econstructor; eauto.
Qed.

The argument at a position of glued arguments is glued at its parameter's type, read in the environment of the arguments before it.
Lemma glu_tele_args_nth_env : forall Δ ts ρ Ms Ns args, glu_tele_args Δ ts ρ Ms Ns args ->
    forall k N c, List.nth_error Ns k = Some N -> List.nth_error args k = Some c ->
    exists κ A a (i : nat) P El, List.nth_error ts k = Some (ce_ass κ A) /\
      ⟦ A ⟧ env_tele ρ ts (List.firstn k args) ↘ a /\ DG a ∈ glu_univ_elem i ↘ P ↘ El /\
      Δ ⊢ A[sb_of_list sb_closed_base (Ms ++ List.firstn k Ns)] ® P /\
      Δ ⊢ N : A[sb_of_list sb_closed_base (Ms ++ List.firstn k Ns)] ® c ∈ El.
Proof.
  induction 1; intros [| k] N0 c0 HN Hc; cbn in HN, Hc; try discriminate.
  - injection HN as <-; injection Hc as <-.
    exists κ, A, a, i, P, El; cbn [List.firstn]; rewrite app_nil_r; repeat split; assumption.
  - destruct (IHglu_tele_args _ _ _ HN Hc) as (κ' & A' & a' & i' & P' & El' & Hnth & Ea & Hg & HP & HN').
    exists κ', A', a', i', P', El'; cbn [List.firstn List.nth_error]; rewrite <- app_assoc in HP, HN'; cbn [List.app] in HP, HN'.
    repeat split; try assumption.
Qed.

Typed arguments of a telescope, the first ones only.
Lemma args_ok_firstn : forall Γ T l, params_evaluated gc_deps gc_stack nil T l ->
    forall Ns, args_ok gc_deps gc_stack Γ T Ns -> forall k, args_ok gc_deps gc_stack Γ T (List.firstn k Ns).
Proof.
  intros * HRT Ns; induction Ns as [| N Ns IH] using List.rev_ind; intros Hok k.
  - rewrite firstn_nil; exact Hok.
  - destruct (Nat.le_gt_cases k (List.length Ns)) as [Hle | Hgt].
    + rewrite firstn_app, (proj2 (Nat.sub_0_le _ _) Hle), app_nil_r.
      exact (IH (proj1 (args_ok_init _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hok HRT)) k).
    + rewrite firstn_all2 by (rewrite length_app; cbn; lia); exact Hok.
Qed.

List facts about the position of the next argument.
Lemma skipn_nth_cons : forall {X} (l : list X) k x, List.nth_error l k = Some x -> List.skipn k l = x :: List.skipn (S k) l.
Proof. intros X l k; revert l; induction k as [| k IH]; intros [| y l] x H; cbn in *; try discriminate; [ injection H as ->; reflexivity | auto ]. Qed.

Lemma firstn_succ_nth : forall {X} (l : list X) k x, List.nth_error l k = Some x -> List.firstn (S k) l = List.firstn k l ++ x :: nil.
Proof. intros X l k; revert l; induction k as [| k IH]; intros [| y l] x H; cbn in *; try discriminate; [ injection H as ->; reflexivity | f_equal; auto ]. Qed.

The rest of a telescope past k arguments ends in the next parameter.
Lemma firstn_rest_split : forall (T : ctx) k e, k < List.length T -> List.nth_error (List.rev T) k = Some e ->
    List.firstn (List.length T - k) T = List.firstn (List.length T - S k) T ++ e :: nil.
Proof.
  intros * Hlt Hnth.
  pose proof (List.nth_error_split _ _ Hnth) as (l1 & l2 & Erev & Hl1).
  assert (ET : T = List.rev l2 ++ e :: List.rev l1)
    by (rewrite <- (List.rev_involutive T), Erev, List.rev_app_distr; cbn; rewrite <- List.app_assoc; reflexivity).
  rewrite ET, List.length_app; cbn [List.length]; rewrite !List.length_rev, Hl1.
  replace (List.length l2 + S k - k) with (List.length (List.rev l2) + 1) by (rewrite List.length_rev; lia).
  replace (List.length l2 + S k - S k) with (List.length (List.rev l2)) by (rewrite List.length_rev; lia).
  rewrite !List.firstn_app, !List.firstn_all2, Nat.sub_diag by lia.
  rewrite List.firstn_all.
  replace (List.length (List.rev l2) + 1 - List.length (List.rev l2)) with 1 by lia; cbn; rewrite app_nil_r; reflexivity.
Qed.

Arguments glued against a telescope are glued against it extended further out.
Lemma glu_tele_args_app_r : forall Δ ts ρ Ms Ns args, glu_tele_args Δ ts ρ Ms Ns args ->
    forall ts2, glu_tele_args Δ (ts ++ ts2) ρ Ms Ns args.
Proof.
  induction 1; intros; cbn [List.app]; [ constructor |].
  econstructor; eauto.
Qed.

A substituted description whose module part reads a stored module reads it before the substitution: substitution keeps the stored path, its telescope and its body.
Lemma mdesc_sub_closed_back : forall R σ Θ' p T Φ Ns, mdesc_mod (mdesc_sub R σ) = Some (mdesc_closed Θ' p T Φ Ns) ->
    exists Θ'' Ns', mdesc_mod R = Some (mdesc_closed Θ'' p T Φ Ns').
Proof.
  intros * Hm; destruct (mdesc_mod_sub_inv _ _ _ Hm) as (R'' & HR'' & E).
  destruct R''; cbn in E; try discriminate; injection E as _ <- <- <- _.
  do 2 eexists; exact HR''.
Qed.

A description given an argument whose module part reads a stored module reads it before: an open module part stays open, a closed one keeps its path, telescope and body.
Lemma mdesc_at_closed_back : forall R N R' Θ' p T Φ Ns, mdesc_at R N = Some R' ->
    mdesc_mod R' = Some (mdesc_closed Θ' p T Φ Ns) -> exists Θ'' Ns', mdesc_mod R = Some (mdesc_closed Θ'' p T Φ Ns').
Proof.
  intros * Hat Hm'.
  destruct (mdesc_mod R) as [Rm |] eqn:Hm; [| rewrite (mdesc_at_no_mod _ _ _ Hm Hat) in Hm'; discriminate ].
  destruct (mdesc_at_mod_part _ _ _ _ Hat Hm) as (Rm' & HRm' & E).
  rewrite Hm' in E.
  pose proof (mdesc_mod_is_mod _ _ Hm) as Hmm.
  destruct Rm as [| Δ0 Φ0 Φx0 | Θ0 p0 T0 Φ0 Ns0 |]; cbn in Hmm; try contradiction; cbn in HRm'.
  -
An open module part stays open
    destruct (tele_split (List.rev Δ0)) as [[[? ?] ?] |]; [ injection HRm' as <- | discriminate ]; cbn in E; discriminate.
  - destruct (tele_split (List.rev Θ0)) as [[[? ?] ?] |]; injection HRm' as <-; cbn in E; injection E as _ <- <- <- _;
      do 2 eexists; reflexivity.
Qed.

The global facts a selection of y from a stored module p reads: the module's telescope and the submodule's glued, and an alias submodule's literal glued over no context.
Record glu_sel_globals_at (p : qname) (y : String.string) : Prop := mk_glu_sel_globals_at
  {
The module's telescope is glued
    glu_sel_globals_at_tele : forall T Φ, gc_loc gc_deps gc_stack p = Some (T, Φ) -> ⊩ T
    
So is the submodule's
  ; glu_sel_globals_at_child_tele : forall T' Φ', gc_loc gc_deps gc_stack (qname_in p y) = Some (T', Φ') -> ⊩ T'
    
An alias submodule's literal is glued over no context
  ; glu_sel_globals_at_child_alias : forall U, gc_module gc_deps gc_stack (qname_in p y) = Some (mr_alias U) ->
      glu_modexp_at ⋅ (me_lit U) }.

The global facts a selection of y from H0 reads, at the modules its descriptions name at every substitution (glu_sel_globals_at). They hold at the target of a sound embedding for a selection typed at the source, the module and the submodule being stored there.
Definition glu_sel_globals (Γ0 : ctx) (H0 : modexp) (y : String.string) : Prop :=
  forall Γ1 ζ RH Θ' p T Φ Ns, Γ1 ⊢ˢ ζ : Γ0 -> mdenote gc_deps gc_stack Γ1 H0[ζ]ᵐ RH ->
    mdesc_mod RH = Some (mdesc_closed Θ' p T Φ Ns) -> glu_sel_globals_at p y.

They pass to the application of H0 weakened to a variable: its descriptions' module parts, when closed, are H0's (mdesc_at_closed_back).
Lemma glu_sel_globals_app_shift : forall Γ0 H0 y Γ1 ζ e,
    glu_sel_globals Γ0 H0 y -> Γ1 ⊢ˢ ζ : Γ0 -> ⊢ (e :: Γ1)%list ->
    glu_sel_globals (e :: Γ1)%list (me_app H0[ζ]ᵐ[Wk]ᵐ #0) y.
Proof.
  intros * Hs Hζ He Γ2 ζ2 RH Θ' p T Φ Ns Hζ2 Hm HRH; cbn [modexp_sub] in Hm.
  inversion Hm; subst; try match goal with H : mod_qname (me_app _ _) = Some _ |- _ => cbn in H; discriminate end.
  match goal with Hat : mdesc_at ?R0 _ = Some RH, Hm0 : mdenote _ _ _ _ ?R0 |- _ =>
    destruct (mdesc_at_closed_back _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hat HRH) as (Θ'' & Ns' & HR0);
    rewrite !modexp_sub_sub in Hm0; refine (Hs _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hm0 HR0) end.
  eapply wf_sub_compose; [ exact Hζ | eapply wf_sub_compose; [ eapply wf_sub_shift; exact He | exact Hζ2 ] ].
Qed.

A body submodule of a saturated glued global module, a stored module at its path, at the same arguments, is glued: as a global module along its telescope (glu_dmod_global_path), the module part of the selection being the stored module (global_sel_desc).
Lemma glu_dmod_sel_global_loc : ⊢ᵍ gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ->
    forall Δ σ0 Γ0 H0 p T Φ args y T' Φ',
    Δ ⊢ˢ σ0 : Γ0 -> gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ⍮ Γ0 ⊢ᵐ H0 ≈ H0 ->
    gc_loc gc_deps gc_stack p = Some (T, Φ) -> List.length args = List.length T ->
    (forall Δ' φ Γ1 ζ σ1 RH, glu_sub_through Δ σ0 Γ0 Δ' φ Γ1 ζ σ1 ->
       mdenote gc_deps gc_stack Γ1 H0[ζ]ᵐ RH -> exists Ns1, mdesc_mod RH = Some (mdesc_closed nil p T Φ Ns1)) ->
    (forall Δ' φ Γ1 ζ σ1 RH Ns1, glu_sub_through Δ σ0 Γ0 Δ' φ Γ1 ζ σ1 ->
       mdenote gc_deps gc_stack Γ1 H0[ζ]ᵐ RH -> mdesc_mod RH = Some (mdesc_closed nil p T Φ Ns1) ->
       glu_tele_args Δ' (List.rev T) nil nil (List.map (fun N => N[σ1]) Ns1) args) ->
    gc_loc gc_deps gc_stack (qname_in p y) = Some (T', Φ') -> ⊩ T' ->
    gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ⍮ Γ0 ⊢ᵐ me_mem H0 y ≈ me_mem H0 y ->
    (forall Γ1 ζ, Γ1 ⊢ˢ ζ : Γ0 -> names_no_frame (me_mem H0 y)[ζ]ᵐ) ->
    glu_dmod Δ σ0 Γ0 (me_mem H0 y) (dm_global (qname_in p y) args).
Proof.
  intros Hgw * Hσ HH0 Hl Hlen Hd Ha Hl' HT' HHy Hq.
  pose proof (wf_gstack_closed _ _ Hgw) as Hc.
  destruct (loc_child_tele _ _ Hgw _ _ _ _ _ _ Hl Hl') as (Z & -> & _).
The module part of the selection at every factorization
  assert (Hsel : forall Δ' φ Γ1 ζ σ1 RH, glu_sub_through Δ σ0 Γ0 Δ' φ Γ1 ζ σ1 ->
            mdenote gc_deps gc_stack Γ1 (me_mem H0 y)[ζ]ᵐ RH ->
            exists Ns1 R0, mdenote gc_deps gc_stack Γ1 H0[ζ]ᵐ R0 /\ mdesc_mod R0 = Some (mdesc_closed nil p T Φ Ns1) /\
              mdesc_mod RH = Some (mdesc_closed nil (qname_in p y) (Z ++ T) Φ' Ns1)).
  { intros * Hst Hm; cbn [modexp_sub] in Hm.
    pose proof (glu_sub_through_mid _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hst) as Hζ.
    pose proof (sub_preserves_modexp _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HH0 Hζ) as HH0ζ.
    pose proof (sub_preserves_modexp _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HHy Hζ) as HHyζ; cbn [modexp_sub] in HHyζ.
    destruct (me_denotes _ _ _ _ _ HH0ζ) as (R0 & R0m & Hm0 & _).
    destruct (Hd _ _ _ _ _ _ Hst Hm0) as (Ns1 & HNs1).
    destruct (modexp_mod_part _ _ _ HHyζ Hm) as (Rm & HRm).
    destruct (global_sel_desc Hgw _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ (Hq _ _ Hζ) Hm0 HNs1 Hl Hm HRm Hl') as (-> & _).
    exists Ns1, R0; repeat split; assumption. }
  eapply (glu_dmod_global_path _ _ _ Hgw Hl' (gc_loc_tele_all_assumptions _ _ Hgw _ _ _ Hl')
            (proj1 (gc_loc_closed _ _ _ _ _ Hc Hl')) HT' (List.length Z));
    [ rewrite length_app; lia | exact Hσ | exact HHy | |].
  - intros * Hst Hm; destruct (Hsel _ _ _ _ _ _ Hst Hm) as (Ns1 & _ & _ & _ & HRm); eauto.
  - intros * Hst Hm HNs; destruct (Hsel _ _ _ _ _ _ Hst Hm) as (Ns1' & R0 & Hm0 & HR0 & HRm).
    rewrite HRm in HNs; injection HNs as <-.
    rewrite rev_app_distr; apply glu_tele_args_app_r; exact (Ha _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hst Hm0 HR0).
Qed.

A glued module value lacking a parameter, applied to a typed argument of its next parameter's type whose instance is glued at every gluing of the parameter's value, is glued as the application: as the application to the variable, read through Id,,N (the value-level core of glu_modexp_at_app).
Lemma glu_dmod_app_val : forall Δ σ Γ H h R T B T1 Srt N a c hc,
    Δ ⊢ˢ σ : Γ -> glu_dmod Δ σ Γ H h ->
    mdenote gc_deps gc_stack Γ H R -> mdesc_mod_tele R = Some T -> tele_view T = Some (B, T1) ->
    Γ ⊢ B : Srt -> type_sort Srt -> Γ ⊢ N : B ->
    next_param h a ->
    (forall (i : nat) P El, DG a ∈ glu_univ_elem i ↘ P ↘ El -> Δ ⊢ B[σ] ® P -> Δ ⊢ N[σ] : B[σ] ® c ∈ El) ->
    $ᵐ| h & c | gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ↘ hc ->
    glu_dmod Δ σ Γ (me_app H N) hc.
Proof.
  intros * Hσt Hg Hm HT Hv HB HS HNt Hn HNg Hhc.
  inversion Hg; subst;
    [ exfalso; eapply next_param_global_sat; eassumption
    | exfalso; inversion Hn; subst; match goal with Hl : _ ++ _ :: nil = nil |- _ => destruct Δ0; discriminate end |].
  match goal with Hn' : next_param h ?a0 |- _ => pose proof (next_param_functional _ _ Hn _ Hn') as <- end.
  match goal with
  | Hp : forall Δ' φ Γ1 ζ σ1 RH, glu_sub_through _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ -> mdenote _ _ _ _ RH -> exists _ _ _, _,
    Ha : forall Δ' φ Γ1 ζ σ1 RH T B T1 Srt, glu_sub_through _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ -> _ |- _ => rename Hp into Hpar, Ha into Happ
  end.
  pose proof (glu_sub_through_id _ _ _ Hσt) as Hst.
  rewrite <- (modexp_sub_id H) in Hm.
  destruct (Hpar _ _ _ _ _ _ Hst Hm) as (T' & B' & T1' & [HT' Hv' Hgl]).
  rewrite HT in HT'; injection HT' as <-; rewrite Hv in Hv'; injection Hv' as <- <-.
  destruct (Hgl _ HS HB) as (j & Pa & Ela & [Hga HBPa]).
  pose proof (HNg _ _ _ Hga HBPa) as HNa.
The parameter's kind, the value's
  destruct (type_sort_abs_kind_sort_inv _ HS) as (κs & l & ->).
  pose proof (sub_preserves_exp _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HB Hσt) as HBσ; rewrite abs_kind_sort_sub in HBσ.
  destruct (glu_univ_elem_typ_kind _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hga HBPa HBσ) as [Hka _].
  pose proof (Happ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hst Hm HT Hv HS HB _ _ _ _ _ _ Hga HBPa HNa Hhc) as Hg1.
  rewrite Hka in Hg1.
  pose proof (sort_kind_abs_kind_sort κs l) as Hsk.
  assert (HNσt : Δ ⊢ N[σ] : B[σ]) by exact (glu_univ_elem_trm_escape _ _ _ _ Hga _ _ _ _ HNa).
  assert (HId : Γ ⊢ˢ Id,,N : Γ ▹{κs} B)
    by (eapply wf_sub_extend; [ exact (wf_sub_id _ _ _ (wf_sub_cod _ _ _ _ _ Hσt)) | exact HB | exact Hsk | rewrite exp_sub_id; exact HNt ]).
  assert (Hsb : sb_eq ((Id,,N) ⨟ σ) (σ,,N[σ])) by (intros [| k]; reflexivity).
  assert (Heq : Δ ⊢ˢ σ,,N[σ] ≈ (Id,,N) ⨟ σ : Γ ▹{κs} B).
  { apply wf_sub_eq_of_sb_eq; [ eapply wf_sub_extend; [ exact Hσt | exact HB | exact Hsk | exact HNσt ] | symmetry; exact Hsb ]. }
  pose proof (proj1 glu_dmod_through _ _ _ _ _ Hg1 _ _ _ HId Hσt Heq) as Hg2.
  assert (EH : (me_app H[Id]ᵐ[Wk]ᵐ #0)[Id,,N]ᵐ = me_app H N).
  { cbn [modexp_sub]; rewrite !modexp_sub_sub; f_equal.
    rewrite <- (modexp_sub_id H) at 2; apply modexp_sub_sb_eq; intros [| k]; reflexivity. }
  rewrite EH in Hg2; exact Hg2.
Qed.

A glued literal alias over a stored telescope extended, at its closure over no environment, given typed arguments for the stored telescope glued against it, is glued as the literal applied to them, one argument at a time (glu_dmod_app_val): the closure lacks each in turn, in the environment of those before.
Lemma glu_dmod_lit_alias_apps : ⊢ᵍ gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ->
    forall Δ σ0 Γ0 Δ0 T E Ns1 args h1 r l,
    Δ ⊢ˢ σ0 : Γ0 -> all_assumptions T -> ctx_scoped 0 T -> ⊩ T -> params_evaluated gc_deps gc_stack nil T l ->
    args_ok gc_deps gc_stack Γ0 T Ns1 -> List.length Ns1 = List.length T ->
    glu_tele_args Δ (List.rev T) nil nil (List.map (fun N => N[σ0]) Ns1) args ->
    glu_dmod Δ σ0 Γ0 (me_lit (gu_mk (Δ0 ++ T) (md_alias E))) h1 ->
    (Δ0 ++ T <> nil -> h1 = dm_local (Δ0 ++ T) (md_alias E) nil) ->
    $ᵐ*| h1 & args | gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ↘ r ->
    glu_dmod Δ σ0 Γ0 (me_apps (me_lit (gu_mk (Δ0 ++ T) (md_alias E))) Ns1) r.
Proof.
  intros Hgw * Hσ HTa HTs HT HRT Hok Hlen Hargs Hg0 Hh1 Happs.
  pose proof (wf_sub_dom _ _ _ _ _ Hσ) as HΔ.
  pose proof (glu_tele_args_length _ _ _ _ _ _ Hargs) as HlA; rewrite length_map in HlA.
  set (U := gu_mk (Δ0 ++ T) (md_alias E)) in *.
  assert (Hind : forall k, k <= List.length T -> exists hk,
             $ᵐ*| h1 & List.firstn k args | gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ↘ hk /\ $ᵐ*| hk & List.skipn k args | gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ↘ r /\
             glu_dmod Δ σ0 Γ0 (me_apps (me_lit U) (List.firstn k Ns1)) hk /\
             (Δ0 ++ List.firstn (List.length T - k) T <> nil ->
              hk = dm_local (Δ0 ++ List.firstn (List.length T - k) T) (md_alias E) (env_tele nil (List.rev T) (List.firstn k args)))).
  { induction k as [| k IH]; intros Hk.
    - exists h1; cbn [List.firstn List.skipn]; split; [ constructor | split; [ exact Happs | split; [ exact Hg0 |] ] ].
      rewrite Nat.sub_0_r, List.firstn_all; intros Hne; rewrite (Hh1 Hne); reflexivity.
    - destruct (IH ltac:(lia)) as (hk & Hpre & Hrest & Hgk & Hform).
      destruct (List.nth_error Ns1 k) as [N |] eqn:HN; [| apply List.nth_error_None in HN; lia ].
      destruct (List.nth_error args k) as [c |] eqn:Hc; [| apply List.nth_error_None in Hc; lia ].
      rewrite (skipn_nth_cons _ _ _ Hc) in Hrest.
      inversion Hrest as [| ? ? hk' ? ? Happ1 Hrest']; subst.
The argument at k, glued
      assert (HNσ : List.nth_error (List.map (fun N => N[σ0]) Ns1) k = Some N[σ0]) by (rewrite List.nth_error_map, HN; reflexivity).
      destruct (glu_tele_args_nth_env _ _ _ _ _ _ Hargs _ _ _ HNσ Hc) as (κ & A & a & i & P & El & Hnth & Ea & Hga & HAP & HNg).
      cbn [List.app] in HAP, HNg.
Its kind, by the telescope's gluing
      destruct (glu_tele_next_param T Δ (List.firstn k (List.map (fun N => N[σ0]) Ns1)) (List.firstn k args) HΔ HTa HT
                  ltac:(rewrite List.firstn_length_le by lia; lia) (glu_tele_args_prefix _ _ _ _ _ _ Hargs k))
        as (κ' & A' & a' & i' & P' & El' & Hnth' & Ea' & Hka & _ & _).
      rewrite List.firstn_length_le in Hnth' by lia; rewrite Hnth in Hnth'; injection Hnth' as <- <-.
      pose proof (functional_eval_exp _ _ _ _ Ea' Ea) as ->.
The closure lacks it
      rewrite (firstn_rest_split T k _ ltac:(lia) Hnth), app_assoc in Hform.
      pose proof (Hform ltac:(intros Hnil; apply app_eq_nil in Hnil as [_ Hnil]; discriminate)) as ->.
      assert (Hnp : next_param (dm_local ((Δ0 ++ List.firstn (List.length T - S k) T) ++ ce_ass κ A :: nil) (md_alias E)
                                  (env_tele nil (List.rev T) (List.firstn k args))) a)
        by (constructor; [ exact Ea | exact Hka ]).
The literal applied so far, its telescope ending in the parameter
      set (Ms := List.firstn k Ns1) in *.
      assert (HlMs : List.length Ms = k) by (unfold Ms; rewrite List.firstn_length_le; lia).
      assert (HHk : gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ⍮ Γ0 ⊢ᵐ me_apps (me_lit U) Ms ≈ me_apps (me_lit U) Ms) by (destruct Hgk; assumption).
      destruct (me_mod_tele_exists HHk) as (Rk & Tk & Hmk & HTk).
      destruct (lit_alias_apps_desc Γ0 Δ0 T E Ms Rk HTa ltac:(lia) Hmk) as (RE & RmE & _ & HmodE & ->).
      rewrite HlMs in HTk.
      destruct (mdesc_mod_tele_up_inv _ _ _ HTk) as (T0' & ->).
      rewrite HlMs in Hmk.
      destruct (tele_rest_view T Ms κ A ltac:(lia) ltac:(rewrite HlMs; exact Hnth)) as (T1 & HT1).
      rewrite HlMs in HT1.
      set (σk := sb_of_list Id Ms) in *.
      assert (HvK : exists T1', tele_view (T0' ++ tele_sub (Δ0 ++ List.firstn (List.length T - k) T) σk) = Some (A[σk], T1')).
      { rewrite tele_sub_app, HT1, !app_assoc, tele_view_last; eexists; reflexivity. }
      destruct HvK as (T1' & HvK).
The argument and its type, typed
      pose proof (args_ok_firstn _ _ _ HRT _ Hok (S k)) as HokS.
      rewrite (firstn_succ_nth _ _ _ HN) in HokS.
      destruct (args_ok_init _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HokS HRT) as (_ & T1o & κ' & C & T2 & HTe & Hl2 & HσMs & (Srt & HSrt & HC) & HNt).
      fold Ms in Hl2, HσMs, HNt.
      assert (HC' : List.nth_error (List.rev T) k = Some (ce_ass κ' C)).
      { rewrite HTe, List.rev_app_distr; cbn [List.rev]; rewrite <- app_assoc; cbn [List.app].
        rewrite List.nth_error_app2 by (rewrite List.length_rev; lia).
        rewrite List.length_rev, Hl2, HlMs, Nat.sub_diag; reflexivity. }
      rewrite Hnth in HC'; injection HC' as <- <-.
      pose proof (sub_preserves_exp _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HC HσMs) as HCσ.
      replace Srt[sb_of_list Id Ms] with Srt in HCσ by (destruct HSrt; reflexivity).
      pose proof (evaluated_sort_type_sort _ HSrt) as HS'.
The argument glued at every gluing of the parameter's value
      assert (HNarg : forall (i0 : nat) P0 El0, DG a ∈ glu_univ_elem i0 ↘ P0 ↘ El0 -> Δ ⊢ A[σk][σ0] ® P0 ->
                 Δ ⊢ N[σ0] : A[σk][σ0] ® c ∈ El0).
      { intros * Hga0 HP0.
        pose proof (sub_preserves_exp _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HCσ Hσ) as HAσ.
        replace Srt[σ0] with Srt in HAσ by (destruct HSrt; reflexivity).
        unfold σk in HP0, HAσ |- *.
        rewrite (tele_type_inst_sub A Ms σ0 ltac:(rewrite HlMs; exact (tele_next_scoped _ _ _ _ HTs Hnth))) in HP0, HAσ |- *.
        rewrite List.firstn_map in HNg; fold Ms in HNg.
        destruct (type_sort_abs_kind_sort_inv _ HS') as (κs & j & ESrt); rewrite ESrt in HAσ.
        destruct (glu_univ_elem_typ_kind _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hga0 HP0 HAσ) as [_ Hnl].
        exact (glu_elem_move_typ Hga Hga0 Hnl HNg HP0). }
      pose proof (glu_dmod_app_val _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ hk' Hσ Hgk Hmk HTk HvK HCσ HS' HNt Hnp HNarg Happ1) as Hgk'.
      exists hk'; split; [| split; [ exact Hrest' | split ] ].
      + rewrite (firstn_succ_nth _ _ _ Hc); apply appms_snoc; eexists; split; [ exact Hpre | exact Happ1 ].
      + unfold Ms in Hgk'; rewrite (firstn_succ_nth _ _ _ HN), me_apps_snoc; exact Hgk'.
      + intros Hne; clear - Happ1 Hne Hc Hnth Hk HlA Hlen.
        inversion Happ1 as [| Δ1 κ1 A1 D1 ρ1 n1 r1 Hcl Heq | ]; subst.
        apply app_inj_tail in Heq as [-> [= -> ->]].
        inversion Hcl as [| ? ? ? ? Hlt0 | ? ? ? ? Hnil]; subst;
          [| exfalso; apply Hne; match goal with H : _ = nil |- _ => exact H | H : nil = _ |- _ => symmetry; exact H end ].
        assert (E1 : env_tele nil (List.rev T) (List.firstn k args) = env_tele nil (List.firstn k (List.rev T)) (List.firstn k args))
          by (rewrite env_tele_firstn, List.firstn_length_le by lia; reflexivity).
        rewrite (firstn_succ_nth _ _ _ Hc), (env_tele_firstn nil (List.rev T) (List.firstn k args ++ c :: nil)), length_app.
        rewrite List.firstn_length_le by lia; cbn [List.length].
        replace (k + 1) with (S k) by lia.
        rewrite (firstn_succ_nth _ _ _ Hnth), env_tele_snoc by (rewrite !List.firstn_length_le by (rewrite ?List.length_rev; lia); reflexivity).
        rewrite E1; reflexivity.
  }
  destruct (Hind (List.length T) (le_n _)) as (hk & _ & Hrest & Hgk & _).
  rewrite List.skipn_all2 in Hrest by lia; inversion Hrest; subst.
  rewrite List.firstn_all2 in Hgk by lia; exact Hgk.
Qed.

An alias submodule of a saturated glued global module, the closure of the stored alias given the module's arguments, is glued as the selection: the stored alias literal is glued over no context (glu_gctx_embedding_alias_modexp), moved to the selection's context, given the arguments (glu_dmod_lit_alias_apps), and moved to the selection, which has its module part (global_sel_alias_desc).
Lemma glu_dmod_sel_global_alias : ⊢ᵍ gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ->
    forall Δ σ0 Γ0 H0 p T Φ args y Δa Da h1 r,
    Δ ⊢ˢ σ0 : Γ0 -> gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ⍮ Γ0 ⊢ᵐ H0 ≈ H0 ->
    gc_loc gc_deps gc_stack p = Some (T, Φ) -> List.length args = List.length T ->
    (forall Δ' φ Γ1 ζ σ1 RH, glu_sub_through Δ σ0 Γ0 Δ' φ Γ1 ζ σ1 ->
       mdenote gc_deps gc_stack Γ1 H0[ζ]ᵐ RH -> exists Ns1, mdesc_mod RH = Some (mdesc_closed nil p T Φ Ns1)) ->
    (forall Δ' φ Γ1 ζ σ1 RH Ns1, glu_sub_through Δ σ0 Γ0 Δ' φ Γ1 ζ σ1 ->
       mdenote gc_deps gc_stack Γ1 H0[ζ]ᵐ RH -> mdesc_mod RH = Some (mdesc_closed nil p T Φ Ns1) ->
       glu_tele_args Δ' (List.rev T) nil nil (List.map (fun N => N[σ1]) Ns1) args) ->
    gc_module gc_deps gc_stack (qname_in p y) = Some (mr_alias (gu_mk Δa Da)) -> glu_sel_globals_at p y ->
    ⟦ Δa ⊢ Da ⟧ᶜ gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ⍮ nil ↘ h1 -> $ᵐ*| h1 & args | gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ↘ r ->
    gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ⍮ Γ0 ⊢ᵐ me_mem H0 y ≈ me_mem H0 y ->
    (forall Γ1 ζ, Γ1 ⊢ˢ ζ : Γ0 -> names_no_frame (me_mem H0 y)[ζ]ᵐ) ->
    glu_dmod Δ σ0 Γ0 (me_mem H0 y) r.
Proof.
  intros Hgw * Hσ HH0 Hl Hlen Hd Ha Hmod Hgl Hcl Happs HHy Hq.
  pose proof (wf_sub_dom _ _ _ _ _ Hσ) as HΔ.
  pose proof (wf_sub_cod _ _ _ _ _ Hσ) as HwΓ0.
  pose proof (wf_gstack_closed _ _ Hgw) as Hc.
  pose proof (Hq _ Id (wf_sub_id _ _ _ HwΓ0)) as Hq0; rewrite modexp_sub_id in Hq0.
The module's description and arguments
  pose proof (glu_sub_through_id _ _ _ Hσ) as Hst0.
  destruct (me_denotes _ _ _ _ _ HH0) as (R0 & Rm0 & Hm0 & _).
  pose proof Hm0 as Hm0'; rewrite <- (modexp_sub_id H0) in Hm0'.
  destruct (Hd _ _ _ _ _ _ Hst0 Hm0') as (Ns1 & HNs1).
  pose proof (Ha _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hst0 Hm0' HNs1) as Hargs.
  pose proof (glu_tele_args_length _ _ _ _ _ _ Hargs) as HlN; rewrite length_map in HlN.
The selection's description
  destruct (me_mod_tele_exists HHy) as (Rsel & TS & HmS & _).
  destruct (modexp_mod_part _ _ _ HHy HmS) as (Rsm & HRsm).
  destruct (global_sel_alias_desc Hgw _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hq0 Hm0 HNs1 Hl ltac:(lia) HmS HRsm Hmod)
    as (E & Δ0 & RE & RmE & -> & -> & HsU & _ & _ & _).
  set (U := gu_mk (Δ0 ++ T) (md_alias E)) in *.
The literal, glued over no context
  assert (Hnil : EG ⋅ ∈ glu_ctx_env ↘ nil_glu_sub_pred) by (eapply glu_ctx_env_nil; [ reflexivity | exact Hgw ]).
  destruct (glu_sel_globals_at_child_alias _ _ Hgl _ Hmod _ Hnil Δ σ0 nil (wf_sub_nil' _ _ HΔ)) as (h' & Eh' & Hg').
  assert (Ecl : ⟦ Δ0 ++ T ⊢ md_alias E ⟧ᶜ gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ⍮ nil ↘ h') by (inversion Eh'; subst; assumption).
  pose proof (functional_eval_close _ _ _ _ _ Ecl Hcl) as ->.
Moved to the selection's context
